# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/pi/`

- `packages/ai/` (~8.7k LOC TS) — provider adapters behind one contract:
  `stream(model, context, options) → AssistantMessageEventStream`.
  Study these files before writing any provider code:
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts` (~1205 LOC) — the
    canonical adapter; also covers OpenRouter (`baseUrl` swap, first-class).
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` (~1242 LOC) — includes a
    hand-rolled SSE decoder at lines 260–409; port this to Dart.
  - `packages/ai/src/stream.ts` — event contract:
    `start → text/thinking/toolcall_{start,delta,end} → done|error`, every
    delta event carries the **live partial message** (partial-first design).
  - `packages/ai/src/utils/overflow.ts` — provider-specific context-overflow
    detection via error-message regexes.
  - **Invariant to preserve: providers never throw.** All failures —
    network, 429, abort, malformed SSE — arrive as an `error` event with
    `stopReason: error|aborted`. The agent loop never sees an exception from
    a provider.
- `packages/agent/` (~8.1k LOC TS):
  - `packages/agent/src/agent-loop.ts` (748 LOC) — the low-level async loop;
    port its shape, not its incidental JS-isms.
  - `packages/agent/src/agent.ts` (557 LOC) — stateful `Agent` with
    **steering / follow-up queues** (inject user messages mid-run — this is
    first-class behavior we must keep) and hooks (`beforeToolCall`,
    `afterToolCall`, `transformContext`, `prepareNextTurn`).
  - session layer — sessions as an **append-only JSONL tree** of records
    (branching, labels). Flat linear history is not acceptable.
  - compaction pipeline (~760 LOC) — `estimateTokens` (chars/4 heuristic,
    images ≈ 1200 tokens) → `shouldCompact` (reserve 16384 tokens) →
    `findCutPoint` (keep ~20k recent tokens) → `generateSummary` via LLM with
    a fixed structured prompt. Token-based, never message-count-based.
  - `ExecutionEnv` abstraction (FileSystem + Shell) — our portability
    boundary: default implementation uses `dart:io`, a web implementation
    can be backed by browser storage, all behind one interface.

### Dart-idiom reference — agenix

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/agenix/packages/agenix/`

Steal idioms, **not architecture** (agenix has no streaming, no events, no
native tool calling, message-count memory — all rejected):

- `lib/src/static/agenix_exceptions.dart` — sealed exception hierarchy with

    timeout-minutes: 20

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      # action's cache key embeds the resolved SDK version, so an SDK bump

          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=

Now the picture is clear:

1. **Quality gate** failed ONLY because `R_BUILD_ANDROID: failure` — the aggregate is red because the build-android platform leg is red. Every other leg passed. So the Quality gate failure is a downstream cascade of the Android build failure. There's exactly ONE root cause: **Build Android APK (debug)**.

2. **Build Android APK (debug)** failed at step `flutter build apk (debug)`:
  - Task `:jni:configureCMakeDebug[arm64-v8a]`
  - `com.android.builder.sdk.InstallFailedException: Failed to install the following SDK components: cmake;3.22.1`
  - `Caused by: java.util.zip.ZipException: Archive is not a ZIP archive` — "Install CMake 3.22.1 v.3.22.1" failed.

So the AGP tried to auto-install CMake 3.22.1 into the Android SDK, downloaded a corrupt/non-zip file, and failed. This is the classic "SDK component auto-download got an HTML error page / corrupt archive" issue, OR the sdkmanager license/proxy issue where the "downloaded" file isn't a zip.

There's a CI step `./.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall` that passed — it probably preinstalls NDK + cmake. Let me look at that action to see what it preinstalls — maybe it installs a specific CMake version but the jni module's build.gradle.kts pins a different one (3.22.1), and auto-install kicked in and failed.

The interesting part: the ticket mentions the repo has a `jni` package? `:jni:configureCMakeDebug` — there's a Gradle module named `jni` in flutter_app/android. Let me explore:

- `flutter_app/android/` settings.gradle.kts — includes `:jni`
- `flutter_app/android/jni/build.gradle.kts` — externalNativeBuild with cmake version
- `.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall/action.yml` — what it preinstalls

The fix options:
1. Make CI preinstall `cmake;3.22.1` via sdkmanager before the build (so AGP doesn't auto-install).
2. Pin the cmake version in jni/build.gradle.kts to the one that IS preinstalled.

Let me look at the files. Also — importantly — the ticket says the failures were on the tag v1.0.619. Is this failure still present on main HEAD? The relevant files (android config, CI workflow) probably didn't change between v1.0.619 and main (#1754 only touched compaction code). So yes, still broken.

Note the "Advance vpinned marker" job also failed — job 119439481402. Let me check that one too; it might be a different failure (maybe it failed because the run was red). Let me check.

Root cause chain is emerging: Quality gate failed **only** because `R_BUILD_ANDROID: failure` — a cascade. The single real failure is the Android build: `:jni:configureCMakeDebug[arm64-v8a]` → `cmake;3.22.1` auto-install → `ZipException: Archive is not a ZIP archive`. Let me check the third failed job and then dig into the repo config.

name: android-ndk-preinstall
description: >-
  Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK so Gradle configuration never
  triggers an on-demand sdkmanager download mid-build. gh-1655: one
  truncated android-ndk-r28c-linux download ("Error on ZipFile unknown
  archive" at 33%) red'd the ci.yml build-android leg — and the aggregate
  Quality gate with it — because AGP's in-configuration auto-install path
  has NO retry. The NDK version is resolved from the pinned Flutter SDK's
  own gradle plugin source (the exact value flutter.ndkVersion resolves
  to — no second pin to drift), the install is skipped when the NDK is
  already present, and the download itself is bounded-retried — the same
  hardening the flutter_gemma Android seed carries (gh-1468). Companion
  guard: test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart.
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK (bounded retry)
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        # flutter.ndkVersion's single source of truth: the gradle plugin
        # bundled with the SDK flutter-action installed. app/
        # build.gradle.kts reads `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion`, so
        # resolving here can never skew from what AGP requests at
        # configuration time (a literal pin on either side would break
        # that coupling — the guard test pins both sides).
        if [ -n "${FLUTTER_ROOT:-}" ]; then
          FLUTTER_HOME="$FLUTTER_ROOT"
        else
          FLUTTER_BIN="$(command -v flutter || true)"
          if [ -z "$FLUTTER_BIN" ]; then
            echo "::error::cannot locate flutter (set FLUTTER_ROOT) — the NDK pre-install resolves the version from the SDK's gradle plugin source"
            exit 1
          fi
          FLUTTER_HOME="$(dirname "$(dirname "$FLUTTER_BIN")")"
        fi
        GRADLE_SRC="$FLUTTER_HOME/packages/flutter_tools/gradle/src/main/kotlin/FlutterExtension.kt"
        NDK_VERSION="$(grep -hoE 'val ndkVersion: String = "[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+"' "$GRADLE_SRC" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | head -1 || true)"
        if [ -z "$NDK_VERSION" ]; then
          echo "::error::cannot resolve flutter.ndkVersion from $GRADLE_SRC — the Flutter gradle plugin layout moved; update the extraction in .github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall (and test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart) TOGETHER"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "resolved flutter.ndkVersion = $NDK_VERSION"
        ANDROID_SDK="${ANDROID_HOME:-/usr/local/lib/android/sdk}"
        SDKMANAGER="$ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager"
        if [ ! -x "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
          SDKMANAGER="$(command -v sdkmanager || true)"
        fi
        if [ -z "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
          echo "::error::sdkmanager not found (expected $ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager) — the NDK pre-install needs the Android cmdline-tools"
          exit 1
        fi
        # Idempotence: AGP resolves `ndkVersion` against
        # $ANDROID_HOME/ndk/<version> — source.properties present means
        # the NDK is fully installed; skip the download entirely.
        if [ -f "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION/source.properties" ]; then
          echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION already installed — skipping pre-install"
          exit 0
        fi
        # Accept any license the image has not pre-accepted so the
        # installs below never prompt (|| true: `yes` dies of SIGPIPE by
        # design once sdkmanager stops reading).
        yes | "$SDKMANAGER" --licenses > /dev/null || true
        # gh-1655: Gradle's own auto-install (the same sdkmanager call,
        # run inside configuration) has no retry — one truncated download
        # unzips as "Error on ZipFile unknown archive" and the build dies.
        # Here the same download gets three attempts with backoff.
        for attempt in 1 2 3; do
          echo "installing NDK $NDK_VERSION (attempt $attempt/3)"
          rm -rf "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION"
          if "$SDKMANAGER" --install "ndk;$NDK_VERSION"; then
            echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION installed"
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "::warning::sdkmanager NDK install failed (attempt $attempt/3) — retrying in 10s"
          sleep 10
        done
        echo "::error::NDK $NDK_VERSION install failed after 3 attempts — gh-1655 red'd the leg on a single truncated archive; inspect the sdkmanager output above"
        exit 1

===
# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,

  on every new user

pr_base_branch.txt
# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/pi/`

- `packages/ai/` (~8.7k LOC TS) — provider adapters behind one contract:
  `stream(model, context, options) → AssistantMessageEventStream`.
  Study these files before writing any provider code:
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts` (~1205 LOC) — the
    canonical adapter; also covers OpenRouter (`baseUrl` swap, first-class).
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` (~1242 LOC) — includes a
    hand-rolled SSE decoder at lines 260–409; port this to Dart.
  - `packages/ai/src/stream.ts` — event contract:
    `start → text/thinking/toolcall_{start,delta,end} → done|error`, every
    delta event carries the **live partial message** (partial-first design).
  - `packages/ai/src/utils/overflow.ts` — provider-specific context-overflow
    detection via error-message regexes.
  - **Invariant to preserve: providers never throw.** All failures —
    network, 429, abort, malformed SSE — arrive as an `error` event with
    `stopReason: error|aborted`. The agent loop never sees an exception from
    a provider.
- `packages/agent/` (~8.1k LOC TS):
  - `packages/agent/src/agent-loop.ts` (748 LOC) — the low-level async loop;
    port its shape, not its incidental JS-isms.
  - `packages/agent/src/agent.ts` (557 LOC) — stateful `Agent` with
    **steering / follow-up queues** (inject user messages mid-run — this is
    first-class behavior we must keep) and hooks (`beforeToolCall`,
    `afterToolCall`, `transformContext`, `prepareNextTurn`).
  - session layer — sessions as an **append-only JSONL tree** of records
    (branching, labels). Flat linear history is not acceptable.
  - compaction pipeline (~760 LOC) — `estimateTokens` (chars/4 heuristic,
    images ≈ 1200 tokens) → `shouldCompact` (reserve 16384 tokens) →
    `findCutPoint` (keep ~20k recent tokens) → `generateSummary` via LLM with
    a fixed structured prompt. Token-based, never message-count-based.
  - `ExecutionEnv` abstraction (FileSystem + Shell) — our portability
    boundary: default implementation uses `dart:io`, a web implementation
    can be backed by browser storage, all behind one interface.

### Dart-idiom reference — agenix

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/agenix/packages/agenix/`

Steal idioms, **not architecture** (agenix has no streaming, no events, no
native tool calling, message-count memory — all rejected):

- `lib/src/static/agenix_exceptions.dart` — sealed exception hierarchy with

    timeout-minutes: 20

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      # Pinned to the same SDK as the release path (#281): 3.47.x. The
      # action's cache key embeds the resolved SDK version, so an SDK bump
      # in a PR never restores a poisoned cache (E1).

      - name: Create placeholder .env asset

name: android-ndk-preinstall
description: >-
  Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK so Gradle configuration never
  triggers an on-demand sdkmanager download mid-build. gh-1655: one
  truncated android-ndk-r28c-linux download ("Error on ZipFile unknown
  archive" at 33%) red'd the ci.yml build-android leg — and the aggregate
  Quality gate with it — because AGP's in-configuration auto-install path
  has NO retry. The NDK version is resolved from the pinned Flutter SDK's
  own gradle plugin source (the exact value flutter.ndkVersion resolves
  to — no second pin to drift), the install is skipped when the NDK is
  already present, and the download itself is bounded-retried — the same
  hardening the flutter_gemma Android seed carries (gh-1468). Companion
  guard: test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart.
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK (bounded retry)
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        # flutter.ndkVersion's single source of truth: the gradle plugin
        # bundled with the SDK flutter-action installed. app/
        # build.gradle.kts reads `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion`, so
        # resolving here can never skew from what AGP requests at
        # configuration time (a literal pin on either side would break
        # that coupling — the guard test pins both sides).
        if [ -n "${FLUTTER_ROOT:-}" ]; then
          FLUTTER_HOME="$FLUTTER_ROOT"
        else
          FLUTTER_BIN="$(command -v flutter || true)"
          if [ -z "$FLUTTER_BIN" ]; then
            echo "::error::cannot locate flutter (set FLUTTER_ROOT) — the NDK pre-install resolves the version from the SDK's gradle plugin source"
            exit 1
          fi
          FLUTTER_HOME="$(dirname "$(dirname "$FLUTTER_BIN")")"
        fi
        GRADLE_SRC="$FLUTTER_HOME/packages/flutter_tools/gradle/src/main/kotlin/FlutterExtension.kt"
        NDK_VERSION="$(grep -hoE 'val ndkVersion: String = "[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+"' "$GRADLE_SRC" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | head -1 || true)"
        if [ -z "$NDK_VERSION" ]; then
          echo "::error::cannot resolve flutter.ndkVersion from $GRADLE_SRC — the Flutter gradle plugin layout moved; update the extraction in .github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall (and test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart) TOGETHER"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "resolved flutter.ndkVersion = $NDK_VERSION"
        ANDROID_SDK="${ANDROID_HOME:-/usr/local/lib/android/sdk}"
        SDKMANAGER="$ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager"
        if [ ! -x "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
          SDKMANAGER="$(command -v sdkmanager || true)"
        fi
        if [ -z "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
          echo "::error::sdkmanager not found (expected $ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager) — the NDK pre-install needs the Android cmdline-tools"
          exit 1
        fi
        # Idempotence: AGP resolves `ndkVersion` against
        # $ANDROID_HOME/ndk/<version> — source.properties present means
        # the NDK is fully installed; skip the download entirely.
        if [ -f "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION/source.properties" ]; then
          echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION already installed — skipping pre-install"
          exit 0
        fi
        # Accept any license the image has not pre-accepted so the
        # installs below never prompt (|| true: `yes` dies of SIGPIPE by
        # design once sdkmanager stops reading).
        yes | "$SDKMANAGER" --licenses > /dev/null || true
        # gh-1655: Gradle's own auto-install (the same sdkmanager call,
        # run inside configuration) has no retry — one truncated download
        # unzips as "Error on ZipFile unknown archive" and the build dies.
        # Here the same download gets three attempts with backoff.
        for attempt in 1 2 3; do
          echo "installing NDK $NDK_VERSION (attempt $attempt/3)"
          rm -rf "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION"
          if "$SDKMANAGER" --install "ndk;$NDK_VERSION"; then
            echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION installed"
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "::warning::sdkmanager NDK install failed (attempt $attempt/3) — retrying in 10s"
          sleep 10
        done
        echo "::error::NDK $NDK_VERSION install failed after 3 attempts — gh-1655 red'd the leg on a single truncated archive; inspect the sdkmanager output above"
        exit 1

name: flutter-gemma-android-seed
description: >-
  Pre-seed the flutter_gemma LiteRT-LM Android native cache so the
  flutter_gemma_litertlm build hook never downloads
  litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz mid-build. gh-1468: one HTTP 500 from the
  github.com release-asset CDN during that download red'd the ci.yml
  build-android leg (and the aggregate Quality gate with it). The hook
  short-circuits the download entirely once libLiteRtLm.so and a matching
  .flutter_gemma_native_version marker exist in the cache — same
  hardening the macOS legs carry via "Ensure flutter_gemma macOS companion
  dylibs". The version/checksum below MUST equal the hook's _litertlmBundle
  registration in the pinned flutter_gemma_litertlm (hook/build.dart);
  test/ci_gemma_android_seed_guard_test.dart AC3 cross-checks both sides.
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Seed flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        GEMMA_CACHE="$HOME/.cache/flutter_gemma/native"
        PLATFORM_DIR="$GEMMA_CACHE/android_arm64"
        MARKER="$GEMMA_CACHE/.flutter_gemma_native_version"
        # The hook's cache-dedup predicate: main lib present AND the
        # marker carries this bundle's exact version (its
        # _invalidateBundleCacheIfStale wipes owned files on a version
        # mismatch, so a stale seed would be deleted and re-downloaded
        # mid-build — the roulette this action exists to stop).
        if [ -f "$PLATFORM_DIR/libLiteRtLm.so" ] && \
           grep -q '"version":"0.17.1-a"\|"version": *"0.17.1-a"' "$MARKER" 2>/dev/null; then
          echo "flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs already cached ($PLATFORM_DIR)"
        else
          echo "seeding flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs from native-v0.17.1-a"
          mkdir -p "$PLATFORM_DIR"
          curl -L --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
            -o /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz \
            https://github.com/DenisovAV/flutter_gemma/releases/download/native-v0.17.1-a/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz
          echo "745b89b606eb712a78f06aed41daca1370eae79b00e0a36054c8e775c0251768  /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
          tar xzf /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz -C "$PLATFORM_DIR"
          # Marker commit point: {version, owner} exactly as the hook's
          # _writeMarker emits it (owner = the hook's _packageName) so the
          # pre-seeded cache keeps a single CodeAsset registrant.
          printf '{"version":"0.17.1-a","owner":"flutter_gemma_litertlm"}\n' > "$MARKER"
        fi
        ls -la "$PLATFORM_DIR"

# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/pi/`

- `packages/ai/` (~8.7k LOC TS) — provider adapters behind one contract:
  `stream(model, context, options) → AssistantMessageEventStream`.
  Study these files before writing any provider code:
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts` (~1205 LOC) — the
    canonical adapter; also covers OpenRouter (`baseUrl` swap, first-class).
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` (~1242 LOC) — includes a
    hand-rolled SSE decoder at lines 260–409; port this to Dart.
  - `packages/ai/src/stream.ts` — event contract:
    `start → text/thinking/toolcall_{start,delta,end} → done|error`, every

  - `packages/ai/src/utils/overflow.ts` — provider-specific context-overflow

So the AGP tried to auto-install CMake 3.22.1 into the Android SDK, downloaded a corrupt/non-zip file, and failed. This is the classic "SDK component auto-download got an HTML error page / corrupt archive" issue, OR the sdkmanager license/proxy issue where the "downloaded" file isn't a zip.

name: android-ndk-preinstall
description: >-
  Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK so Gradle configuration never
  triggers an on-demand sdkmanager download mid-build. gh-1655: one
  truncated android-ndk-r28c-linux download ("Error on ZipFile unknown
  archive" at 33%) red'd the ci.yml build-android leg — and the aggregate
  Quality gate with it — because AGP's in-configuration auto-install path
  has NO retry. The NDK version is resolved from the pinned Flutter SDK's
  own gradle plugin source (the exact value flutter.ndkVersion resolves
  to — no second pin to drift), the install is skipped when the NDK is
  already present, and the download itself is bounded-retried — the same
  hardening the flutter_gemma Android seed carries (gh-1468). Companion
  guard: test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart.
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK (bounded retry)
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        # flutter.ndkVersion's single source of truth: the gradle plugin
        # bundled with the SDK flutter-action installed. app/
        # build.gradle.kts reads `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion`, so
        # resolving here can never skew from what AGP requests at
        # configuration time (a literal pin on either side would break
        # that coupling — the guard test pins both sides).
        if [ -n "${FLUTTER_ROOT:-}" ]; then
          FLUTTER_HOME="$FLUTTER_ROOT"
        else
          FLUTTER_BIN="$(command -v flutter || true)"
          if [ -z "$FLUTTER_BIN" ]; then
            echo "::error::cannot locate flutter (set FLUTTER_ROOT) — the NDK pre-install resolves the version from the SDK's gradle plugin source"
            exit 1
          fi
          FLUTTER_HOME="$(dirname "$(dirname "$FLUTTER_BIN")")"
        fi
        GRADLE_SRC="$FLUTTER_HOME/packages/flutter_tools/gradle/src/main/kotlin/FlutterExtension.kt"
        NDK_VERSION="$(grep -hoE 'val ndkVersion: String = "[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+"' "$GRADLE_SRC" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | head -1 || true)"
        if [ -z "$NDK_VERSION" ]; then
          echo "::error::cannot resolve flutter.ndkVersion from $GRADLE_SRC — the Flutter gradle plugin layout moved; update the extraction in .github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall (and test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart) TOGETHER"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "resolved flutter.ndkVersion = $NDK_VERSION"
        ANDROID_SDK="${ANDROID_HOME:-/usr/local/lib/android/sdk}"
        SDKMANAGER="$ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager"
        if [ ! -x "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
          SDKMANAGER="$(command -v sdkmanager || true)"
        fi
        if [ -z "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
          echo "::error::sdkmanager not found (expected $ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager) — the NDK pre-install needs the Android cmdline-tools"
          exit 1
        fi
        # Idempotence: AGP resolves `ndkVersion` against
        # $ANDROID_HOME/ndk/<version> — source.properties present means
        # the NDK is fully installed; skip the download entirely.
        if [ -f "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION/source.properties" ]; then
          echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION already installed — skipping pre-install"
          exit 0
        fi
        # Accept any license the image has not pre-accepted so the
        # installs below never prompt (|| true: `yes` dies of SIGPIPE by
        # design once sdkmanager stops reading).
        yes | "$SDKMANAGER" --licenses > /dev/null || true
        # gh-1655: Gradle's own auto-install (the same sdkmanager call,
        # run inside configuration) has no retry — one truncated download
        # unzips as "Error on ZipFile unknown archive" and the build dies.
        # Here the same download gets three attempts with backoff.
        for attempt in 1 2 3; do
          echo "installing NDK $NDK_VERSION (attempt $attempt/3)"
          rm -rf "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION"
          if "$SDKMANAGER" --install "ndk;$NDK_VERSION"; then
            echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION installed"
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "::warning::sdkmanager NDK install failed (attempt $attempt/3) — retrying in 10s"
          sleep 10
        done
        echo "::error::NDK $NDK_VERSION install failed after 3 attempts — gh-1655 red'd the leg on a single truncated archive; inspect the sdkmanager output above"
        exit 1

---
name: flutter-gemma-android-seed
description: >-
  Pre-seed the flutter_gemma LiteRT-LM Android native cache so the
  flutter_gemma_litertlm build hook never downloads
  litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz mid-build. gh-1468: one HTTP 500 from the
  github.com release-asset CDN during that download red'd the ci.yml
  build-android leg (and the aggregate Quality gate with it). The hook
  short-circuits the download entirely once libLiteRtLm.so and a matching
  .flutter_gemma_native_version marker exist in the cache — same
  hardening the macOS legs carry via "Ensure flutter_gemma macOS companion
  dylibs". The version/checksum below MUST equal the hook's _litertlmBundle
  registration in the pinned flutter_gemma_litertlm (hook/build.dart);
  test/ci_gemma_android_seed_guard_test.dart AC3 cross-checks both sides.
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Seed flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        GEMMA_CACHE="$HOME/.cache/flutter_gemma/native"
        PLATFORM_DIR="$GEMMA_CACHE/android_arm64"
        MARKER="$GEMMA_CACHE/.flutter_gemma_native_version"
        # The hook's cache-dedup predicate: main lib present AND the
        # marker carries this bundle's exact version (its
        # _invalidateBundleCacheIfStale wipes owned files on a version
        # mismatch, so a stale seed would be deleted and re-downloaded
        # mid-build — the roulette this action exists to stop).
        if [ -f "$PLATFORM_DIR/libLiteRtLm.so" ] && \
           grep -q '"version":"0.17.1-a"\|"version": *"0.17.1-a"' "$MARKER" 2>/dev/null; then
          echo "flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs already cached ($PLATFORM_DIR)"
        else
          echo "seeding flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs from native-v0.17.1-a"
          mkdir -p "$PLATFORM_DIR"
          curl -L --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
            -o /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz \
            https://github.com/DenisovAV/flutter_gemma/releases/download/native-v0.17.1-a/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz
          echo "745b89b606eb712a78f06aed41daca1370eae79b00e0a36054c8e775c0251768  /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
          tar xzf /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz -C "$PLATFORM_DIR"
          # Marker commit point: {version, owner} exactly as the hook's
          # _writeMarker emits it (owner = the hook's _packageName) so the
          # pre-seeded cache keeps a single CodeAsset registrant.
          printf '{"version":"0.17.1-a","owner":"flutter_gemma_litertlm"}\n' > "$MARKER"
        fi
        ls -la "$PLATFORM_DIR"

There's already a pattern of hardening these mid-build downloads:
- gh-1468: flutter_gemma native download → seed action
- gh-165: NDK auto-install → preinstall action with bounded retry

Now the failure: `:jni:configureCMakeDebug[arm64-v8a]` → "Install CMake 3.22.1" failed with ZipException.

Which plugin is `:jni`? Likely `flutter_gemma_litertlm` — it's a CodeAsset (native code) plugin. Native assets in Flutter for Android with CMake — the `:jni` module... Actually `:jni` is the standard module name used by **native assets** (`package:native_assets_cli`) in Flutter: the synthetic Gradle module for native code is called `jni`. Yes! Flutter's native-assets support creates a `:jni` subproject in the android build (in `flutter_app/android/build/jni` or similar) configured with CMake. The cmake version comes from... hmm.

Actually let me check the pub cache for flutter_gemma_litertlm and see its hook/build.dart. But first — what cmake does AGP request? The failing task is `:jni:configureCMakeDebug[arm64-v8a]` and the component auto-installed is `cmake;3.22.1` — the AGP default CMake version (AGP's default is 3.22.1 since AGP 7.x).

The GitHub ubuntu-latest runner image preinstalls specific CMake versions in the Android SDK: `$ANDROID_HOME/cmake/<version>`. Historically: 3.6.411459, 3.10.2, 3.18.1, 3.22.1, 3.30.x... The image changes over time. If 3.22.1 was recently REMOVED from the runner image (or the preinstalled cmake dir was restructured), AGP would auto-install it — and that auto-install has no retry, and this time the download was corrupted (ZipException) → build red.

Wait — but actually the more robust interpretation: AGP's auto-install of SDK components downloads from dl.google.com; a truncated download → "Archive is not a ZIP archive". Exactly the gh-165 failure mode but for CMake.

The established repo fix pattern (gh-165, gh-1468): a preinstall/seed action that performs the download with bounded retry BEFORE gradle runs, with idempotence skip and guard tests.

So the fix: extend `.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall/action.yml` to ALSO preinstall `cmake;3.22.1` (or resolve the requested cmake version like it resolves ndkVersion). Where does 3.22.1 come from? AGP 9.0.1's default. Since the :jni module is generated by Flutter's native-assets gradle code, the cmake version likely comes from Flutter's gradle plugin or defaults to AGP default.

Let me check:
1. How the `:jni` module gets created — is it in flutter SDK? Search flutter SDK source for "configureCMakeDebug" or "jni".
2. What cmake version the jni module requests.
3. Whether the runner image has cmake 3.22.1 preinstalled.

pr_base_branch.txt
# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/pi/`

- `packages/ai/` (~8.7k LOC TS) — provider adapters behind one contract:
  `stream(model, context, options) → AssistantMessageEventStream`.
  Study these files before writing any provider code:
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts` (~1205 LOC) — the
    canonical adapter; also covers OpenRouter (`baseUrl` swap, first-class).
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` (~1242 LOC) — includes a
    hand-rolled SSE decoder at lines 260–409; port this to Dart.
  - `packages/ai/src/stream.ts` — event contract:
    `start → text/thinking/toolcall_{start,delta,end} → done|error`, every
    delta event carries the **live partial message** (partial-first design).
  - `packages/ai/src/utils/overflow.ts` — provider-specific context-overflow
    detection via error-message regexes.
  - **Invariant to preserve: providers never throw.** All failures —
    network, 429, abort, malformed SSE — arrive as an `error` event with
    `stopReason: error|aborted`. The agent loop never sees an exception from
    a provider.
- `packages/agent/` (~8.1k LOC TS):
  - `packages/agent/src/agent-loop.ts` (748 LOC) — the low-level async loop;
    port its shape, not its incidental JS-isms.
  - `packages/agent/src/agent.ts` (557 LOC) — stateful `Agent` with
    **steering / follow-up queues** (inject user messages mid-run — this is
    first-class behavior we must keep) and hooks (`beforeToolCall`,
    `afterToolCall`, `transformContext`, `prepareNextTurn`).
  - session layer — sessions as an **append-only JSONL tree** of records
    (branching, labels). Flat linear history is not acceptable.
  - compaction pipeline (~760 LOC) — `estimateTokens` (chars/4 heuristic,
    images ≈ 1200 tokens) → `shouldCompact` (reserve 16384 tokens) →
    `findCutPoint` (keep ~20k recent tokens) → `generateSummary` via LLM with
    a fixed structured prompt. Token-based, never message-count-based.
  - `ExecutionEnv` abstraction (FileSystem + Shell) — our portability
    boundary: default implementation uses `dart:io`, a web implementation
    can be backed by browser storage, all behind one interface.

# PRs never pay). Debug mode on PRs: compile-truth is the goal; release-

  # matrix (nightly.yml). Budgets (#177): ≤8 min warm / ≤15 min cold per
  # leg, ≤10 min wall added to an app-touching PR (legs run in parallel).
  # E4: both macOS legs use GitHub-hosted macos-latest — every job gets its
  # own ephemeral VM, so ios+macos are never serialized on one runner (and
  # PR code never lands on the self-hosted release pool).
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  build-web:
    name: Build web (debug)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    if: (needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true') && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      # Pinned to the same SDK as the release path (#281): 3.47.x. The
      # action's cache key embeds the resolved SDK version, so an SDK bump
      # in a PR never restores a poisoned cache (E1).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.47.x'
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      - name: flutter build web
        # E3: warnings (including the Wasm dry-run diagnostics) are allowed;
        # compile errors fail via the exit code — same fatal semantics as
        # the flutter-tests leg's analyze step.
        run: cd flutter_app && flutter build web

    name: Build Android APK (debug)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    if: (needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true') && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'

          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'
          cache: 'gradle'

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.47.x'
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      # The google-services Gradle plugin (applied unconditionally in
      # android/app/build.gradle.kts) refuses to run without this file.
      # #622 commits a placeholder carrying BOTH flavor clients

So the Quality gate failure is a downstream cascade of the Android build failure. There's exactly ONE root cause: **Build Android APK (debug)**.

  - `com.android.builder.sdk.InstallFailedException: Failed to install the following SDK components: cmake;3.22.1`

So the AGP tried to auto-install CMake 3.22.1 into the Android SDK, downloaded a corrupt/non-zip file, and failed. This is the classic "SDK component auto-download got an HTML error page / corrupt archive" issue, OR the sdkmanager license/proxy issue where the "downloaded" file isn't a zip.

There's a CI step `./.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall` that passed — it probably preinstalls NDK + cmake. Let me look at that action to see what it preinstalls — maybe it installs a specific CMake version but the jni module's build.gradle.kts pins a different one (3.22.1), and auto-install kicked in and failed.

name: android-ndk-preinstall
description: >-
  Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK so Gradle configuration never
  triggers an on-demand sdkmanager download mid-build. gh-1655: one
  truncated android-ndk-r28c-linux download ("Error on ZipFile unknown
  archive" at 33%) red'd the ci.yml build-android leg — and the aggregate
  Quality gate with it — because AGP's in-configuration auto-install path
  has NO retry. The NDK version is resolved from the pinned Flutter SDK's
  own gradle plugin source (the exact value flutter.ndkVersion resolves
  to — no second pin to drift), the install is skipped when the NDK is
  already present, and the download itself is bounded-retried — the same
  hardening the flutter_gemma Android seed carries (gh-1468). Companion
  guard: test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart.
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK (bounded retry)
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        # flutter.ndkVersion's single source of truth: the gradle plugin
        # bundled with the SDK flutter-action installed. app/
        # build.gradle.kts reads `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion`, so
        # resolving here can never skew from what AGP requests at
        # configuration time (a literal pin on either side would break
        # that coupling — the guard test pins both sides).
        if [ -n "${FLUTTER_ROOT:-}" ]; then
          FLUTTER_HOME="$FLUTTER_ROOT"
        else
          FLUTTER_BIN="$(command -v flutter || true)"
          if [ -z "$FLUTTER_BIN" ]; then
            echo "::error::cannot locate flutter (set FLUTTER_ROOT) — the NDK pre-install resolves the version from the SDK's gradle plugin source"
            exit 1
          fi
          FLUTTER_HOME="$(dirname "$(dirname "$FLUTTER_BIN")")"
        fi
        GRADLE_SRC="$FLUTTER_HOME/packages/flutter_tools/gradle/src/main/kotlin/FlutterExtension.kt"
        NDK_VERSION="$(grep -hoE 'val ndkVersion: String = "[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+"' "$GRADLE_SRC" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | head -1 || true)"
        if [ -z "$NDK_VERSION" ]; then
          echo "::error::cannot resolve flutter.ndkVersion from $GRADLE_SRC — the Flutter gradle plugin layout moved; update the extraction in .github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall (and test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart) TOGETHER"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "resolved flutter.ndkVersion = $NDK_VERSION"
        ANDROID_SDK="${ANDROID_HOME:-/usr/local/lib/android/sdk}"
        SDKMANAGER="$ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager"
        if [ ! -x "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
          SDKMANAGER="$(command -v sdkmanager || true)"
        fi
        if [ -z "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
          echo "::error::sdkmanager not found (expected $ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager) — the NDK pre-install needs the Android cmdline-tools"
          exit 1
        fi
        # Idempotence: AGP resolves `ndkVersion` against
        # $ANDROID_HOME/ndk/<version> — source.properties present means
        # the NDK is fully installed; skip the download entirely.
        if [ -f "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION/source.properties" ]; then
          echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION already installed — skipping pre-install"
          exit 0
        fi
        # Accept any license the image has not pre-accepted so the
        # installs below never prompt (|| true: `yes` dies of SIGPIPE by
        # design once sdkmanager stops reading).
        yes | "$SDKMANAGER" --licenses > /dev/null || true
        # gh-1655: Gradle's own auto-install (the same sdkmanager call,
        # run inside configuration) has no retry — one truncated download
        # unzips as "Error on ZipFile unknown archive" and the build dies.
        # Here the same download gets three attempts with backoff.
        for attempt in 1 2 3; do
          echo "installing NDK $NDK_VERSION (attempt $attempt/3)"
          rm -rf "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION"
          if "$SDKMANAGER" --install "ndk;$NDK_VERSION"; then
            echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION installed"
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "::warning::sdkmanager NDK install failed (attempt $attempt/3) — retrying in 10s"
          sleep 10
        done
        echo "::error::NDK $NDK_VERSION install failed after 3 attempts — gh-1655 red'd the leg on a single truncated archive; inspect the sdkmanager output above"
        exit 1

name: flutter-gemma-android-seed
description: >-
  Pre-seed the flutter_gemma LiteRT-LM Android native cache so the
  flutter_gemma_litertlm build hook never downloads
  litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz mid-build. gh-1468: one HTTP 500 from the
  github.com release-asset CDN during that download red'd the ci.yml
  build-android leg (and the aggregate Quality gate with it). The hook
  short-circuits the download entirely once libLiteRtLm.so and a matching
  .flutter_gemma_native_version marker exist in the cache — same
  hardening the macOS legs carry via "Ensure flutter_gemma macOS companion
  dylibs". The version/checksum below MUST equal the hook's _litertlmBundle
  registration in the pinned flutter_gemma_litertlm (hook/build.dart);
  test/ci_gemma_android_seed_guard_test.dart AC3 cross-checks both sides.
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Seed flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        GEMMA_CACHE="$HOME/.cache/flutter_gemma/native"
        PLATFORM_DIR="$GEMMA_CACHE/android_arm64"
        MARKER="$GEMMA_CACHE/.flutter_gemma_native_version"
        # The hook's cache-dedup predicate: main lib present AND the
        # marker carries this bundle's exact version (its
        # _invalidateBundleCacheIfStale wipes owned files on a version
        # mismatch, so a stale seed would be deleted and re-downloaded
        # mid-build — the roulette this action exists to stop).
        if [ -f "$PLATFORM_DIR/libLiteRtLm.so" ] && \
           grep -q '"version":"0.17.1-a"\|"version": *"0.17.1-a"' "$MARKER" 2>/dev/null; then
          echo "flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs already cached ($PLATFORM_DIR)"
        else
          echo "seeding flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs from native-v0.17.1-a"
          mkdir -p "$PLATFORM_DIR"
          curl -L --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
            -o /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz \
            https://github.com/DenisovAV/flutter_gemma/releases/download/native-v0.17.1-a/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz
          echo "745b89b606eb712a78f06aed41daca1370eae79b00e0a36054c8e775c0251768  /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
          tar xzf /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz -C "$PLATFORM_DIR"
          # Marker commit point: {version, owner} exactly as the hook's
          # _writeMarker emits it (owner = the hook's _packageName) so the
          # pre-seeded cache keeps a single CodeAsset registrant.
          printf '{"version":"0.17.1-a","owner":"flutter_gemma_litertlm"}\n' > "$MARKER"
        fi
        ls -la "$PLATFORM_DIR"

Actually `:jni` is the standard module name used by **native assets** (`package:native_assets_cli`) in Flutter: the synthetic Gradle module for native code is called `jni`. Yes! Flutter's native-assets support creates a `:jni` subproject in the android build (in `flutter_app/android/build/jni` or similar) configured with CMake. The cmake version comes from... hmm.

The failing task is `:jni:configureCMakeDebug[arm64-v8a]` and the component auto-installed is `cmake;3.22.1` — the AGP default CMake version (AGP's default is 3.22.1 since AGP 7.x).

  # matrix (nightly.yml). Budgets (#177): ≤8 min warm / ≤15 min cold per
  # leg, ≤10 min wall added to an app-touching PR (legs run in parallel).
  # E4: both macOS legs use GitHub-hosted macos-latest — every job gets its
  # own ephemeral VM, so ios+macos are never serialized on one runner (and
  # PR code never lands on the self-hosted release pool).
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  build-web:
    name: Build web (debug)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    if: (needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true') && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      # Pinned to the same SDK as the release path (#281): 3.47.x. The
      # action's cache key embeds the resolved SDK version, so an SDK bump
      # in a PR never restores a poisoned cache (E1).

blocks.text:
Now the picture is clear:

1. **Quality gate** failed ONLY because `R_BUILD_ANDROID: failure` — the aggregate is red because the build-android platform leg is red. Every other leg passed. So the Quality gate failure is a downstream cascade of the Android build failure. There's exactly ONE root cause: **Build Android APK (debug)**.

2. **Build Android APK (debug)** failed at step `flutter build apk (debug)`:
  - Task `:jni:configureCMakeDebug[arm64-v8a]`
  - `com.android.builder.sdk.InstallFailedException: Failed to install the following SDK components: cmake;3.22.1`
  - `Caused by: java.util.zip.ZipException: Archive is not a ZIP archive` — "Install CMake 3.22.1 v.3.22.1" failed.

So the AGP tried to auto-install CMake 3.22.1 into the Android SDK, downloaded a corrupt/non-zip file, and failed. This is the classic "SDK component auto-download got an HTML error page / corrupt archive" issue, OR the sdkmanager license/proxy issue where the "downloaded" file isn't a zip.

There's a CI step `./.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall` that passed — it probably preinstalls NDK + cmake. Let me look at that action to see what it preinstalls — maybe it installs a specific CMake version but the jni module's build.gradle.kts pins a different one (3.22.1), and auto-install kicked in and failed.

The interesting part: the ticket mentions the repo has a `jni` package? `:jni:configureCMakeDebug` — there's a Gradle module named `jni` in flutter_app/android. Let me explore:

- `flutter_app/android/` settings.gradle.kts — includes `:jni`
- `flutter_app/android/jni/build.gradle.kts` — externalNativeBuild with cmake version
- `.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall/action.yml` — what it preinstalls

The fix options:
1. Make CI preinstall `cmake;3.22.1` via sdkmanager before the build (so AGP doesn't auto-install).
2. Pin the cmake version in jni/build.gradle.kts to the one that IS preinstalled.

Let me look at the files. Also — importantly — the ticket says the failures were on the tag v1.0.619. Is this failure still present on main HEAD? The relevant files (android config, CI workflow) probably didn't change between v1.0.619 and main (#1754 only touched compaction code). So yes, still broken.

Note the "Advance vpinned marker" job also failed — job 119439481402. Let me check that one too; it might be a different failure (maybe it failed because the run was red). Let me check.

The single real failure is the Android build: `:jni:configureCMakeDebug[arm64-v8a]` → `cmake;3.22.1` auto-install → `ZipException: Archive is not a ZIP archive`. name: android-ndk-preinstall
description: >-
  Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK so Gradle configuration never
  triggers an on-demand sdkmanager download mid-build. gh-1655: one
  truncated android-ndk-r28c-linux download ("Error on ZipFile unknown
  archive" at 33%) red'd the ci.yml build-android leg — and the aggregate
  Quality gate with it — because AGP's in-configuration auto-install path
  has NO retry. The NDK version is resolved from the pinned Flutter SDK's
  own gradle plugin source (the exact value flutter.ndkVersion resolves
  to — no second pin to drift), the install is skipped when the NDK is
  already present, and the download itself is bounded-retried — the same
  hardening the flutter_gemma Android seed carries (gh-1468). Companion
  guard: test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart.
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK (bounded retry)
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        # flutter.ndkVersion's single source of truth: the gradle plugin
        # bundled with the SDK flutter-action installed. app/
        # build.gradle.kts reads `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion`, so
        # resolving here can never skew from what AGP requests at
        # configuration time (a literal pin on either side would break
        # that coupling — the guard test pins both sides).
        if [ -n "${FLUTTER_ROOT:-}" ]; then
          FLUTTER_HOME="$FLUTTER_ROOT"
        else
          FLUTTER_BIN="$(command -v flutter || true)"
          if [ -z "$FLUTTER_BIN" ]; then
            echo "::error::cannot locate flutter (set FLUTTER_ROOT) — the NDK pre-install resolves the version from the SDK's gradle plugin source"
            exit 1
          fi
          FLUTTER_HOME="$(dirname "$(dirname "$FLUTTER_BIN")")"
        fi
        GRADLE_SRC="$FLUTTER_HOME/packages/flutter_tools/gradle/src/main/kotlin/FlutterExtension.kt"
        NDK_VERSION="$(grep -hoE 'val ndkVersion: String = "[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+"' "$GRADLE_SRC" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | head -1 || true)"
        if [ -z "$NDK_VERSION" ]; then
          echo "::error::cannot resolve flutter.ndkVersion from $GRADLE_SRC — the Flutter gradle plugin layout moved; update the extraction in .github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall (and test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart) TOGETHER"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "resolved flutter.ndkVersion = $NDK_VERSION"
        ANDROID_SDK="${ANDROID_HOME:-/usr/local/lib/android/sdk}"
        SDKMANAGER="$ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager"
        if [ ! -x "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
          SDKMANAGER="$(command -v sdkmanager || true)"
        fi
        if [ -z "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
          echo "::error::sdkmanager not found (expected $ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager) — the NDK pre-install needs the Android cmdline-tools"
          exit 1
        fi
        # Idempotence: AGP resolves `ndkVersion` against
        # $ANDROID_HOME/ndk/<version> — source.properties present means
        # the NDK is fully installed; skip the download entirely.
        if [ -f "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION/source.properties" ]; then
          echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION already installed — skipping pre-install"
          exit 0
        fi
        # Accept any license the image has not pre-accepted so the
        # installs below never prompt (|| true: `yes` dies of SIGPIPE by
        # design once sdkmanager stops reading).
        yes | "$SDKMANAGER" --licenses > /dev/null || true
        # gh-1655: Gradle's own auto-install (the same sdkmanager call,
        # run inside configuration) has no retry — one truncated download
        # unzips as "Error on ZipFile unknown archive" and the build dies.
        # Here the same download gets three attempts with backoff.
        for attempt in 1 2 3; do
          echo "installing NDK $NDK_VERSION (attempt $attempt/3)"
          rm -rf "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION"
          if "$SDKMANAGER" --install "ndk;$NDK_VERSION"; then
            echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION installed"
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "::warning::sdkmanager NDK install failed (attempt $attempt/3) — retrying in 10s"
          sleep 10
        done
        echo "::error::NDK $NDK_VERSION install failed after 3 attempts — gh-1655 red'd the leg on a single truncated archive; inspect the sdkmanager output above"
        exit 1

name: flutter-gemma-android-seed
description: >-
  Pre-seed the flutter_gemma LiteRT-LM Android native cache so the
  flutter_gemma_litertlm build hook never downloads
  litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz mid-build. gh-1468: one HTTP 500 from the
  github.com release-asset CDN during that download red'd the ci.yml
  build-android leg (and the aggregate Quality gate with it). The hook
  short-circuits the download entirely once libLiteRtLm.so and a matching
  .flutter_gemma_native_version marker exist in the cache — same
  hardening the macOS legs carry via "Ensure flutter_gemma macOS companion
  dylibs". The version/checksum below MUST equal the hook's _litertlmBundle
  registration in the pinned flutter_gemma_litertlm (hook/build.dart);
  test/ci_gemma_android_seed_guard_test.dart AC3 cross-checks both sides.
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Seed flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        GEMMA_CACHE="$HOME/.cache/flutter_gemma/native"
        PLATFORM_DIR="$GEMMA_CACHE/android_arm64"
        MARKER="$GEMMA_CACHE/.flutter_gemma_native_version"
        # The hook's cache-dedup predicate: main lib present AND the
        # marker carries this bundle's exact version (its
        # _invalidateBundleCacheIfStale wipes owned files on a version
        # mismatch, so a stale seed would be deleted and re-downloaded
        # mid-build — the roulette this action exists to stop).
        if [ -f "$PLATFORM_DIR/libLiteRtLm.so" ] && \
           grep -q '"version":"0.17.1-a"\|"version": *"0.17.1-a"' "$MARKER" 2>/dev/null; then
          echo "flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs already cached ($PLATFORM_DIR)"
        else
          echo "seeding flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs from native-v0.17.1-a"
          mkdir -p "$PLATFORM_DIR"
          curl -L --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
            -o /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz \
            https://github.com/DenisovAV/flutter_gemma/releases/download/native-v0.17.1-a/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz
          echo "745b89b606eb712a78f06aed41daca1370eae79b00e0a36054c8e775c0251768  /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
          tar xzf /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz -C "$PLATFORM_DIR"
          # Marker commit point: {version, owner} exactly as the hook's
          # _writeMarker emits it (owner = the hook's _packageName) so the
          # pre-seeded cache keeps a single CodeAsset registrant.
          printf '{"version":"0.17.1-a","owner":"flutter_gemma_litertlm"}\n' > "$MARKER"
        fi
        ls -la "$PLATFORM_DIR"

# PRs never pay). Debug mode on PRs: compile-truth is the goal; release-
  # only concerns (tree-shaking, R8, codesign) live in the nightly release
  # matrix (nightly.yml). Budgets (#177): ≤8 min warm / ≤15 min cold per
  # leg, ≤10 min wall added to an app-touching PR (legs run in parallel).
  # E4: both macOS legs use GitHub-hosted macos-latest — every job gets its
  # own ephemeral VM, so ios+macos are never serialized on one runner (and
  # PR code never lands on the self-hosted release pool).
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  build-web:
    name: Build web (debug)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    if: (needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true') && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      # Pinned to the same SDK as the release path (#281): 3.47.x. The
      # action's cache key embeds the resolved SDK version, so an SDK bump
      # in a PR never restores a poisoned cache (E1).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.47.x'
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      - name: flutter build web
        # E3: warnings (including the Wasm dry-run diagnostics) are allowed;
        # compile errors fail via the exit code — same fatal semantics as
        # the flutter-tests leg's analyze step.
        run: cd flutter_app && flutter build web

  build-android:
    name: Build Android APK (debug)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    if: (needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true') && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: actions/setup-java@b843ebf9b913146b38da2eaa7aeddf76074ae1ad # v6.1.0
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'
          cache: 'gradle'

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.47.x'
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      # The google-services Gradle plugin (applied unconditionally in
      # android/app/build.gradle.kts) refuses to run without this file.
      # #622 commits a placeholder carrying BOTH flavor clients
      # (dev.fa1.app + dev.fa1.app.god); keep it whenever present — the
      # debug-APK smoke pins the store flavor (`--flavor store`, only the
      # dev.fa1.app client is needed); god compile truth is covered by the
      # flavor matrix release job. Only when the file is missing
      # (old forks/history) seed the structurally-valid dev.fa1.app
      # placeholder — debug APKs never talk to Firebase with it; the goal
      # here is compile truth (#280).
      - name: Create placeholder google-services.json
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -f android/app/google-services.json ]; then

name: android-ndk-preinstall
description: >-
  Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK so Gradle configuration never
  triggers an on-demand sdkmanager download mid-build. gh-1655: one
  truncated android-ndk-r28c-linux download ("Error on ZipFile unknown
  archive" at 33%) red'd the ci.yml build-android leg — and the aggregate
  Quality gate with it — because AGP's in-configuration auto-install path
  has NO retry. The NDK version is resolved from the pinned Flutter SDK's
  own gradle plugin source (the exact value flutter.ndkVersion resolves
  to — no second pin to drift), the install is skipped when the NDK is
  already present, and the download itself is bounded-retried — the same
  hardening the flutter_gemma Android seed carries (gh-1468). Companion
  guard: test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart.
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK (bounded retry)
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        # flutter.ndkVersion's single source of truth: the gradle plugin
        # bundled with the SDK flutter-action installed. app/
        # build.gradle.kts reads `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion`, so
        # resolving here can never skew from what AGP requests at
        # configuration time (a literal pin on either side would break
        # that coupling — the guard test pins both sides).
        if [ -n "${FLUTTER_ROOT:-}" ]; then
          FLUTTER_HOME="$FLUTTER_ROOT"
        else
          FLUTTER_BIN="$(command -v flutter || true)"
          if [ -z "$FLUTTER_BIN" ]; then
            echo "::error::cannot locate flutter (set FLUTTER_ROOT) — the NDK pre-install resolves the version from the SDK's gradle plugin source"
            exit 1
          fi
          FLUTTER_HOME="$(dirname "$(dirname "$FLUTTER_BIN")")"
        fi
        GRADLE_SRC="$FLUTTER_HOME/packages/flutter_tools/gradle/src/main/kotlin/FlutterExtension.kt"
        NDK_VERSION="$(grep -hoE 'val ndkVersion: String = "[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+"' "$GRADLE_SRC" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | head -1 || true)"
        if [ -z "$NDK_VERSION" ]; then
          echo "::error::cannot resolve flutter.ndkVersion from $GRADLE_SRC — the Flutter gradle plugin layout moved; update the extraction in .github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall (and test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart) TOGETHER"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "resolved flutter.ndkVersion = $NDK_VERSION"
        ANDROID_SDK="${ANDROID_HOME:-/usr/local/lib/android/sdk}"
        SDKMANAGER="$ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager"
        if [ ! -x "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
          SDKMANAGER="$(command -v sdkmanager || true)"
        fi
        if [ -z "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
          echo "::error::sdkmanager not found (expected $ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager) — the NDK pre-install needs the Android cmdline-tools"
          exit 1
        fi
        # Idempotence: AGP resolves `ndkVersion` against
        # $ANDROID_HOME/ndk/<version> — source.properties present means
        # the NDK is fully installed; skip the download entirely.
        if [ -f "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION/source.properties" ]; then
          echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION already installed — skipping pre-install"
          exit 0
        fi
        # Accept any license the image has not pre-accepted so the
        # installs below never prompt (|| true: `yes` dies of SIGPIPE by
        # design once sdkmanager stops reading).
        yes | "$SDKMANAGER" --licenses > /dev/null || true
        # gh-1655: Gradle's own auto-install (the same sdkmanager call,
        # run inside configuration) has no retry — one truncated download
        # unzips as "Error on ZipFile unknown archive" and the build dies.
        # Here the same download gets three attempts with backoff.
        for attempt in 1 2 3; do
          echo "installing NDK $NDK_VERSION (attempt $attempt/3)"
          rm -rf "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION"
          if "$SDKMANAGER" --install "ndk;$NDK_VERSION"; then
            echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION installed"
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "::warning::sdkmanager NDK install failed (attempt $attempt/3) — retrying in 10s"
          sleep 10
        done
        echo "::error::NDK $NDK_VERSION install failed after 3 attempts — gh-1655 red'd the leg on a single truncated archive; inspect the sdkmanager output above"
        exit 1

---
name: flutter-gemma-android-seed
description: >-
  Pre-seed the flutter_gemma LiteRT-LM Android native cache so the
  flutter_gemma_litertlm build hook never downloads
  litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz mid-build. gh-1468: one HTTP 500 from the
  github.com release-asset CDN during that download red'd the ci.yml
  build-android leg (and the aggregate Quality gate with it). The hook
  short-circuits the download entirely once libLiteRtLm.so and a matching
  .flutter_gemma_native_version marker exist in the cache — same
  hardening the macOS legs carry via "Ensure flutter_gemma macOS companion
  dylibs". The version/checksum below MUST equal the hook's _litertlmBundle
  registration in the pinned flutter_gemma_litertlm (hook/build.dart);
  test/ci_gemma_android_seed_guard_test.dart AC3 cross-checks both sides.
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Seed flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        GEMMA_CACHE="$HOME/.cache/flutter_gemma/native"
        PLATFORM_DIR="$GEMMA_CACHE/android_arm64"
        MARKER="$GEMMA_CACHE/.flutter_gemma_native_version"
        # The hook's cache-dedup predicate: main lib present AND the
        # marker carries this bundle's exact version (its
        # _invalidateBundleCacheIfStale wipes owned files on a version
        # mismatch, so a stale seed would be deleted and re-downloaded
        # mid-build — the roulette this action exists to stop).
        if [ -f "$PLATFORM_DIR/libLiteRtLm.so" ] && \
           grep -q '"version":"0.17.1-a"\|"version": *"0.17.1-a"' "$MARKER" 2>/dev/null; then
          echo "flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs already cached ($PLATFORM_DIR)"
        else
          echo "seeding flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs from native-v0.17.1-a"
          mkdir -p "$PLATFORM_DIR"
          curl -L --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
            -o /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz \
            https://github.com/DenisovAV/flutter_gemma/releases/download/native-v0.17.1-a/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz
          echo "745b89b606eb712a78f06aed41daca1370eae79b00e0a36054c8e775c0251768  /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
          tar xzf /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz -C "$PLATFORM_DIR"
          # Marker commit point: {version, owner} exactly as the hook's
          # _writeMarker emits it (owner = the hook's _packageName) so the
          # pre-seeded cache keeps a single CodeAsset registrant.
          printf '{"version":"0.17.1-a","owner":"flutter_gemma_litertlm"}\n' > "$MARKER"
        fi
        ls -la "$PLATFORM_DIR"

blocks.text:
There's already a pattern of hardening these mid-build downloads:
- gh-1468: flutter_gemma native download → seed action
- gh-165: NDK auto-install → preinstall action with bounded retry

Now the failure: `:jni:configureCMakeDebug[arm64-v8a]` → "Install CMake 3.22.1" failed with ZipException.

Which plugin is `:jni`? Likely `flutter_gemma_litertlm` — it's a CodeAsset (native code) plugin. Native assets in Flutter for Android with CMake — the `:jni` module... Actually `:jni` is the standard module name used by **native assets** (`package:native_assets_cli`) in Flutter: the synthetic Gradle module for native code is called `jni`. Yes! Flutter's native-assets support creates a `:jni` subproject in the android build (in `flutter_app/android/build/jni` or similar) configured with CMake. The cmake version comes from... hmm.

Actually let me check the pub cache for flutter_gemma_litertlm and see its hook/build.dart. But first — what cmake does AGP request? The failing task is `:jni:configureCMakeDebug[arm64-v8a]` and the component auto-installed is `cmake;3.22.1` — the AGP default CMake version (AGP's default is 3.22.1 since AGP 7.x).

The GitHub ubuntu-latest runner image preinstalls specific CMake versions in the Android SDK: `$ANDROID_HOME/cmake/<version>`. Historically: 3.6.411459, 3.10.2, 3.18.1, 3.22.1, 3.30.x... The image changes over time. If 3.22.1 was recently REMOVED from the runner image (or the preinstalled cmake dir was restructured), AGP would auto-install it — and that auto-install has no retry, and this time the download was corrupted (ZipException) → build red.

Wait — but actually the more robust interpretation: AGP's auto-install of SDK components downloads from dl.google.com; a truncated download → "Archive is not a ZIP archive". Exactly the gh-165 failure mode but for CMake.

The established repo fix pattern (gh-165, gh-1468): a preinstall/seed action that performs the download with bounded retry BEFORE gradle runs, with idempotence skip and guard tests.

So the fix: extend `.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall/action.yml` to ALSO preinstall `cmake;3.22.1` (or resolve the requested cmake version like it resolves ndkVersion). Where does 3.22.1 come from? AGP 9.0.1's default. Since the :jni module is generated by Flutter's native-assets gradle code, the cmake version likely comes from Flutter's gradle plugin or defaults to AGP default.

# PRs never pay). Debug mode on PRs: compile-truth is the goal; release-
  # only concerns (tree-shaking, R8, codesign) live in the nightly release
  # matrix (nightly.yml). Budgets (#177): ≤8 min warm / ≤15 min cold per
  # leg, ≤10 min wall added to an app-touching PR (legs run in parallel).
  # E4: both macOS legs use GitHub-hosted macos-latest — every job gets its
  # own ephemeral VM, so ios+macos are never serialized on one runner (and
  # PR code never lands on the self-hosted release pool).
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  build-web:
    name: Build web (debug)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    if: (needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true') && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      # Pinned to the same SDK as the release path (#281): 3.47.x. The
      # action's cache key embeds the resolved SDK version, so an SDK bump
      # in a PR never restores a poisoned cache (E1).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.47.x'
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      - name: flutter build web
        # E3: warnings (including the Wasm dry-run diagnostics) are allowed;
        # compile errors fail via the exit code — same fatal semantics as
        # the flutter-tests leg's analyze step.
        run: cd flutter_app && flutter build web

  build-android:
    name: Build Android APK (debug)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    if: (needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true') && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: actions/setup-java@b843ebf9b913146b38da2eaa7aeddf76074ae1ad # v6.1.0
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'
          cache: 'gradle'

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.47.x'

messages.preview: Root cause chain is emerging: Quality gate failed **only** because `R_BUILD_ANDROID: failure` — a cascade. The single real failure is the Android build: `:jni:configureCMakeDebug[arm64-v8a]` → `cmake;…

blocks.text:
Now the picture is clear:

1. **Quality gate** failed ONLY because `R_BUILD_ANDROID: failure` — the aggregate is red because the build-android platform leg is red. Every other leg passed. So the Quality gate failure is a downstream cascade of the Android build failure. There's exactly ONE root cause: **Build Android APK (debug)**.

2. **Build Android APK (debug)** failed at step `flutter build apk (debug)`:
  - Task `:jni:configureCMakeDebug[arm64-v8a]`
  - `com.android.builder.sdk.InstallFailedException: Failed to install the following SDK components: cmake;3.22.1`
  - `Caused by: java.util.zip.ZipException: Archive is not a ZIP archive` — "Install CMake 3.22.1 v.3.22.1" failed.

So the AGP tried to auto-install CMake 3.22.1 into the Android SDK, downloaded a corrupt/non-zip file, and failed. This is the classic "SDK component auto-download got an HTML error page / corrupt archive" issue, OR the sdkmanager license/proxy issue where the "downloaded" file isn't a zip.

There's a CI step `./.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall` that passed — it probably preinstalls NDK + cmake. Let me look at that action to see what it preinstalls — maybe it installs a specific CMake version but the jni module's build.gradle.kts pins a different one (3.22.1), and auto-install kicked in and failed.

The interesting part: the ticket mentions the repo has a `jni` package? `:jni:configureCMakeDebug` — there's a Gradle module named `jni` in flutter_app/android. Let me explore:

- `flutter_app/android/` settings.gradle.kts — includes `:jni`
- `flutter_app/android/jni/build.gradle.kts` — externalNativeBuild with cmake version
- `.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall/action.yml` — what it preinstalls

The fix options:
1. Make CI preinstall `cmake;3.22.1` via sdkmanager before the build (so AGP doesn't auto-install).
2. Pin the cmake version in jni/build.gradle.kts to the one that IS preinstalled.

Let me look at the files. Also — importantly — the ticket says the failures were on the tag v1.0.619. Is this failure still present on main HEAD? The relevant files (android config, CI workflow) probably didn't change between v1.0.619 and main (#1754 only touched compaction code). So yes, still broken.

Note the "Advance vpinned marker" job also failed — job 119439481402. Let me check that one too; it might be a different failure (maybe it failed because the run was red). Let me check.

Root cause chain is emerging: Quality gate failed **only** because `R_BUILD_ANDROID: failure` — a cascade. The single real failure is the Android build: `:jni:configureCMakeDebug[arm64-v8a]` → `cmake;3.22.1` auto-install → `ZipException: Archive is not a ZIP archive`. Let me check the third failed job and then dig into the repo config.
