messages.preview: Root cause chain is emerging: Quality gate failed **only** because `R_BUILD_ANDROID: failure` — a cascade. The single real failure is the Android build: `:jni:configureCMakeDebug[arm64-v8a]` → `cmake;…

blocks.text:
Now the picture is clear:

1. **Quality gate** failed ONLY because `R_BUILD_ANDROID: failure` — the aggregate is red because the build-android platform leg is red. Every other leg passed. So the Quality gate failure is a downstream cascade of the Android build failure. There's exactly ONE root cause: **Build Android APK (debug)**.

2. **Build Android APK (debug)** failed at step `flutter build apk (debug)`:
  - Task `:jni:configureCMakeDebug[arm64-v8a]`
  - `com.android.builder.sdk.InstallFailedException: Failed to install the following SDK components: cmake;3.22.1`
  - `Caused by: java.util.zip.ZipException: Archive is not a ZIP archive` — "Install CMake 3.22.1 v.3.22.1" failed.

So the AGP tried to auto-install CMake 3.22.1 into the Android SDK, downloaded a corrupt/non-zip file, and failed. This is the classic "SDK component auto-download got an HTML error page / corrupt archive" issue, OR the sdkmanager license/proxy issue where the "downloaded" file isn't a zip.

There's a CI step `./.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall` that passed — it probably preinstalls NDK + cmake. Let me look at that action to see what it preinstalls — maybe it installs a specific CMake version but the jni module's build.gradle.kts pins a different one (3.22.1), and auto-install kicked in and failed.

The interesting part: the ticket mentions the repo has a `jni` package? `:jni:configureCMakeDebug` — there's a Gradle module named `jni` in flutter_app/android. Let me explore:

- `flutter_app/android/` settings.gradle.kts — includes `:jni`
- `flutter_app/android/jni/build.gradle.kts` — externalNativeBuild with cmake version
- `.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall/action.yml` — what it preinstalls

The fix options:
1. Make CI preinstall `cmake;3.22.1` via sdkmanager before the build (so AGP doesn't auto-install).
2. Pin the cmake version in jni/build.gradle.kts to the one that IS preinstalled.

Let me look at the files. Also — importantly — the ticket says the failures were on the tag v1.0.619. Is this failure still present on main HEAD? The relevant files (android config, CI workflow) probably didn't change between v1.0.619 and main (#1754 only touched compaction code). So yes, still broken.

Note the "Advance vpinned marker" job also failed — job 119439481402. Let me check that one too; it might be a different failure (maybe it failed because the run was red). Let me check.

Root cause chain is emerging: Quality gate failed **only** because `R_BUILD_ANDROID: failure` — a cascade. The single real failure is the Android build: `:jni:configureCMakeDebug[arm64-v8a]` → `cmake;3.22.1` auto-install → `ZipException: Archive is not a ZIP archive`. name: android-ndk-preinstall
description: >-
  Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK so Gradle configuration never
  triggers an on-demand sdkmanager download mid-build. gh-1655: one
  truncated android-ndk-r28c-linux download ("Error on ZipFile unknown
  archive" at 33%) red'd the ci.yml build-android leg — and the aggregate
  Quality gate with it — because AGP's in-configuration auto-install path
  has NO retry. The NDK version is resolved from the pinned Flutter SDK's
  own gradle plugin source (the exact value flutter.ndkVersion resolves
  to — no second pin to drift), the install is skipped when the NDK is
  already present, and the download itself is bounded-retried — the same
  hardening the flutter_gemma Android seed carries (gh-1468). Companion
  guard: test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart.
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK (bounded retry)
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        # flutter.ndkVersion's single source of truth: the gradle plugin
        # bundled with the SDK flutter-action installed. app/
        # build.gradle.kts reads `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion`, so
        # resolving here can never skew from what AGP requests at
        # configuration time (a literal pin on either side would break
        # that coupling — the guard test pins both sides).
        if [ -n "${FLUTTER_ROOT:-}" ]; then
          FLUTTER_HOME="$FLUTTER_ROOT"
        else
          FLUTTER_BIN="$(command -v flutter || true)"
          if [ -z "$FLUTTER_BIN" ]; then
            echo "::error::cannot locate flutter (set FLUTTER_ROOT) — the NDK pre-install resolves the version from the SDK's gradle plugin source"
            exit 1
          fi
          FLUTTER_HOME="$(dirname "$(dirname "$FLUTTER_BIN")")"
        fi
        GRADLE_SRC="$FLUTTER_HOME/packages/flutter_tools/gradle/src/main/kotlin/FlutterExtension.kt"
        NDK_VERSION="$(grep -hoE 'val ndkVersion: String = "[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+"' "$GRADLE_SRC" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | head -1 || true)"
        if [ -z "$NDK_VERSION" ]; then
          echo "::error::cannot resolve flutter.ndkVersion from $GRADLE_SRC — the Flutter gradle plugin layout moved; update the extraction in .github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall (and test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart) TOGETHER"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "resolved flutter.ndkVersion = $NDK_VERSION"
        ANDROID_SDK="${ANDROID_HOME:-/usr/local/lib/android/sdk}"
        SDKMANAGER="$ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager"
        if [ ! -x "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
          SDKMANAGER="$(command -v sdkmanager || true)"
        fi
        if [ -z "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
          echo "::error::sdkmanager not found (expected $ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager) — the NDK pre-install needs the Android cmdline-tools"
          exit 1
        fi
        # Idempotence: AGP resolves `ndkVersion` against
        # $ANDROID_HOME/ndk/<version> — source.properties present means
        # the NDK is fully installed; skip the download entirely.
        if [ -f "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION/source.properties" ]; then
          echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION already installed — skipping pre-install"
          exit 0
        fi
        # Accept any license the image has not pre-accepted so the
        # installs below never prompt (|| true: `yes` dies of SIGPIPE by
        # design once sdkmanager stops reading).
        yes | "$SDKMANAGER" --licenses > /dev/null || true
        # gh-1655: Gradle's own auto-install (the same sdkmanager call,
        # run inside configuration) has no retry — one truncated download
        # unzips as "Error on ZipFile unknown archive" and the build dies.
        # Here the same download gets three attempts with backoff.
        for attempt in 1 2 3; do
          echo "installing NDK $NDK_VERSION (attempt $attempt/3)"
          rm -rf "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION"
          if "$SDKMANAGER" --install "ndk;$NDK_VERSION"; then
            echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION installed"
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "::warning::sdkmanager NDK install failed (attempt $attempt/3) — retrying in 10s"
          sleep 10
        done
        echo "::error::NDK $NDK_VERSION install failed after 3 attempts — gh-1655 red'd the leg on a single truncated archive; inspect the sdkmanager output above"
        exit 1

name: flutter-gemma-android-seed
description: >-
  Pre-seed the flutter_gemma LiteRT-LM Android native cache so the
  flutter_gemma_litertlm build hook never downloads
  litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz mid-build. gh-1468: one HTTP 500 from the
  github.com release-asset CDN during that download red'd the ci.yml
  build-android leg (and the aggregate Quality gate with it). The hook
  short-circuits the download entirely once libLiteRtLm.so and a matching
  .flutter_gemma_native_version marker exist in the cache — same
  hardening the macOS legs carry via "Ensure flutter_gemma macOS companion
  dylibs". The version/checksum below MUST equal the hook's _litertlmBundle
  registration in the pinned flutter_gemma_litertlm (hook/build.dart);
  test/ci_gemma_android_seed_guard_test.dart AC3 cross-checks both sides.
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Seed flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        GEMMA_CACHE="$HOME/.cache/flutter_gemma/native"
        PLATFORM_DIR="$GEMMA_CACHE/android_arm64"
        MARKER="$GEMMA_CACHE/.flutter_gemma_native_version"
        # The hook's cache-dedup predicate: main lib present AND the
        # marker carries this bundle's exact version (its
        # _invalidateBundleCacheIfStale wipes owned files on a version
        # mismatch, so a stale seed would be deleted and re-downloaded
        # mid-build — the roulette this action exists to stop).
        if [ -f "$PLATFORM_DIR/libLiteRtLm.so" ] && \
           grep -q '"version":"0.17.1-a"\|"version": *"0.17.1-a"' "$MARKER" 2>/dev/null; then
          echo "flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs already cached ($PLATFORM_DIR)"
        else
          echo "seeding flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs from native-v0.17.1-a"
          mkdir -p "$PLATFORM_DIR"
          curl -L --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
            -o /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz \
            https://github.com/DenisovAV/flutter_gemma/releases/download/native-v0.17.1-a/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz
          echo "745b89b606eb712a78f06aed41daca1370eae79b00e0a36054c8e775c0251768  /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
          tar xzf /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz -C "$PLATFORM_DIR"
          # Marker commit point: {version, owner} exactly as the hook's
          # _writeMarker emits it (owner = the hook's _packageName) so the
          # pre-seeded cache keeps a single CodeAsset registrant.
          printf '{"version":"0.17.1-a","owner":"flutter_gemma_litertlm"}\n' > "$MARKER"
        fi
        ls -la "$PLATFORM_DIR"

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Release v1.0.619 went red on three CI jobs — Build Android APK (debug), Quality gate, Advance vpinned marker — with a single root cause: the Android APK build died installing CMake 3.22.1.

**Root cause**: `flutter build apk` failed in Gradle configuration at task `:jni:configureCMakeDebug[arm64-v8a]` with `InstallFailedException: Failed to install the following SDK components: cmake;3.22.1`, caused by `java.util.zip.ZipException: Archive is not a ZIP archive`. The `:jni` Gradle module is the Flutter plugin of the transitive dependency `jni 1.1.0` (pulled in by `path_provider_android 2.3.1`); its `android/build.gradle` wires `externalNativeBuild.cmake` with the version line commented out upstream (`// version "3.10.2"`), so AGP 9.0.1 (`flutter_app/android/settings.gradle.kts`) falls back to its default CMake 3.22.1. The runner image carries no `$ANDROID_HOME/cmake/3.22.1`, so AGP ran its own in-configuration sdkmanager auto-install — which has NO retry. The download came back truncated/corrupt and the unzip blew up, red'ing the leg. This is exactly the gh-1655 failure class (NDK auto-install, fixed by `.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall`), re-entered through the second SDK component the same configuration step provisions: CMake. The existing action hardens only the NDK download.

**Impact**: One corrupt `cmake;3.22.1` download reds the build-android leg (and identically the release/nightly Android lanes, which ride the same un-preinstalled path). Quality gate reds as a pure cascade — its log shows `R_BUILD_ANDROID: failure` as the ONLY failed input (dart_ok stays true per #1368; the required aggregate check is still red). "Advance vpinned marker" reds as a second cascade: `scripts/pin_release.sh v1.0.619` correctly refused to move the `vpinned` marker because the red release published no `SHA256SUMS` provenance asset. Zero code faults — a transfer fault in an unretryable path.

**Fix approach**: Extend `.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall/action.yml` (the gh-1655 action that already bypasses the unretryable auto-install path before Gradle runs) to also pre-install the AGP-default CMake (`cmake;3.22.1`) with the same hardening: idempotent skip when `$ANDROID_HOME/cmake/3.22.1/bin/cmake` already exists, install through sdkmanager with three bounded attempts and backoff, loud `::error::` when the component is still missing. Every Android build job (ci.yml `build-android`, build-mobile.yml `build-android`/`build-android-apks`, nightly.yml `build-release`) already consumes this action before its build step, so the fix covers the whole class without touching the workflows. blocks.text:
Now the picture is clear:

1. **Quality gate** failed ONLY because `R_BUILD_ANDROID: failure` — the aggregate is red because the build-android platform leg is red. Every other leg passed. So the Quality gate failure is a downstream cascade of the Android build failure. There's exactly ONE root cause: **Build Android APK (debug)**.

2. **Build Android APK (debug)** failed at step `flutter build apk (debug)`:
  - Task `:jni:configureCMakeDebug[arm64-v8a]`
  - `com.android.builder.sdk.InstallFailedException: Failed to install the following SDK components: cmake;3.22.1`
  - `Caused by: java.util.zip.ZipException: Archive is not a ZIP archive` — "Install CMake 3.22.1 v.3.22.1" failed.

So the AGP tried to auto-install CMake 3.22.1 into the Android SDK, downloaded a corrupt/non-zip file, and failed. This is the classic "SDK component auto-download got an HTML error page / corrupt archive" issue, OR the sdkmanager license/proxy issue where the "downloaded" file isn't a zip.

There's a CI step `./.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall` that passed — it probably preinstalls NDK + cmake. Let me look at that action to see what it preinstalls — maybe it installs a specific CMake version but the jni module's build.gradle.kts pins a different one (3.22.1), and auto-install kicked in and failed.

The interesting part: the ticket mentions the repo has a `jni` package? `:jni:configureCMakeDebug` — there's a Gradle module named `jni` in flutter_app/android. Let me explore:

- `flutter_app/android/` settings.gradle.kts — includes `:jni`
- `flutter_app/android/jni/build.gradle.kts` — externalNativeBuild with cmake version
- `.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall/action.yml` — what it preinstalls

The fix options:
1. Make CI preinstall `cmake;3.22.1` via sdkmanager before the build (so AGP doesn't auto-install).
2. Pin the cmake version in jni/build.gradle.kts to the one that IS preinstalled.

Let me look at the files. Also — importantly — the ticket says the failures were on the tag v1.0.619. Is this failure still present on main HEAD? The relevant files (android config, CI workflow) probably didn't change between v1.0.619 and main (#1754 only touched compaction code). So yes, still broken.

Note the "Advance vpinned marker" job also failed — job 119439481402. Let me check that one too; it might be a different failure (maybe it failed because the run was red). Let me check.

Root cause chain is emerging: Quality gate failed **only** because `R_BUILD_ANDROID: failure` — a cascade. The single real failure is the Android build: `:jni:configureCMakeDebug[arm64-v8a]` → `cmake;3.22.1` auto-install → `ZipException: Archive is not a ZIP archive`. Let me check the third failed job and then dig into the repo config.

  triggers an on-demand sdkmanager download mid-build. gh-1655: one
  truncated android-ndk-r28c-linux download ("Error on ZipFile unknown
  archive" at 33%) red'd the ci.yml build-android leg — and the aggregate
  Quality gate with it — because AGP's in-configuration auto-install path
  has NO retry. The NDK version is resolved from the pinned Flutter SDK's
  own gradle plugin source (the exact value flutter.ndkVersion resolves
  to — no second pin to drift), the install is skipped when the NDK is
  already present, and the download itself is bounded-retried — the same
  hardening the flutter_gemma Android seed carries (gh-1468). Companion
  guard: test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart.
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK (bounded retry)
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        # flutter.ndkVersion's single source of truth: the gradle plugin
        # bundled with the SDK flutter-action installed. app/
        # build.gradle.kts reads `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion`, so
        # resolving here can never skew from what AGP requests at
        # configuration time (a literal pin on either side would break
        # that coupling — the guard test pins both sides).
        if [ -n "${FLUTTER_ROOT:-}" ]; then
          FLUTTER_HOME="$FLUTTER_ROOT"
        else
          FLUTTER_BIN="$(command -v flutter || true)"
          if [ -z "$FLUTTER_BIN" ]; then
            echo "::error::cannot locate flutter (set FLUTTER_ROOT) — the NDK pre-install resolves the version from the SDK's gradle plugin source"
            exit 1
          fi
          FLUTTER_HOME="$(dirname "$(dirname "$FLUTTER_BIN")")"
        fi
        GRADLE_SRC="$FLUTTER_HOME/packages/flutter_tools/gradle/src/main/kotlin/FlutterExtension.kt"
        NDK_VERSION="$(grep -hoE 'val ndkVersion: String = "[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+"' "$GRADLE_SRC" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | head -1 || true)"
        if [ -z "$NDK_VERSION" ]; then
          echo "::error::cannot resolve flutter.ndkVersion from $GRADLE_SRC — the Flutter gradle plugin layout moved; update the extraction in .github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall (and test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart) TOGETHER"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "resolved flutter.ndkVersion = $NDK_VERSION"
        ANDROID_SDK="${ANDROID_HOME:-/usr/local/lib/android/sdk}"
        SDKMANAGER="$ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager"
        if [ ! -x "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
          SDKMANAGER="$(command -v sdkmanager || true)"
        fi
        if [ -z "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
          echo "::error::sdkmanager not found (expected $ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager) — the NDK pre-install needs the Android cmdline-tools"
          exit 1
        fi
        # Idempotence: AGP resolves `ndkVersion` against
        # $ANDROID_HOME/ndk/<version> — source.properties present means
        # the NDK is fully installed; skip the download entirely.
        if [ -f "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION/source.properties" ]; then
          echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION already installed — skipping pre-install"
          exit 0
        fi
        # Accept any license the image has not pre-accepted so the
        # installs below never prompt (|| true: `yes` dies of SIGPIPE by
        # design once sdkmanager stops reading).
        yes | "$SDKMANAGER" --licenses > /dev/null || true
        # gh-1655: Gradle's own auto-install (the same sdkmanager call,
        # run inside configuration) has no retry — one truncated download
        # unzips as "Error on ZipFile unknown archive" and the build dies.
        # Here the same download gets three attempts with backoff.
        for attempt in 1 2 3; do
          echo "installing NDK $NDK_VERSION (attempt $attempt/3)"
          rm -rf "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION"
          if "$SDKMANAGER" --install "ndk;$NDK_VERSION"; then
            echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION installed"
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "::warning::sdkmanager NDK install failed (attempt $attempt/3) — retrying in 10s"
          sleep 10
        done
        echo "::error::NDK $NDK_VERSION install failed after 3 attempts — gh-1655 red'd the leg on a single truncated archive; inspect the sdkmanager output above"
        exit 1

name: flutter-gemma-android-seed
description: >-
  Pre-seed the flutter_gemma LiteRT-LM Android native cache so the
  flutter_gemma_litertlm build hook never downloads
  litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz mid-build. gh-1468: one HTTP 500 from the
  github.com release-asset CDN during that download red'd the ci.yml
  build-android leg (and the aggregate Quality gate with it). The hook
  short-circuits the download entirely once libLiteRtLm.so and a matching
  .flutter_gemma_native_version marker exist in the cache — same
  hardening the macOS legs carry via "Ensure flutter_gemma macOS companion
  dylibs". The version/checksum below MUST equal the hook's _litertlmBundle
  registration in the pinned flutter_gemma_litertlm (hook/build.dart);
  test/ci_gemma_android_seed_guard_test.dart AC3 cross-checks both sides.
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Seed flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        GEMMA_CACHE="$HOME/.cache/flutter_gemma/native"
        PLATFORM_DIR="$GEMMA_CACHE/android_arm64"
        MARKER="$GEMMA_CACHE/.flutter_gemma_native_version"
        # The hook's cache-dedup predicate: main lib present AND the
        # marker carries this bundle's exact version (its
        # _invalidateBundleCacheIfStale wipes owned files on a version
        # mismatch, so a stale seed would be deleted and re-downloaded
        # mid-build — the roulette this action exists to stop).
        if [ -f "$PLATFORM_DIR/libLiteRtLm.so" ] && \
           grep -q '"version":"0.17.1-a"\|"version": *"0.17.1-a"' "$MARKER" 2>/dev/null; then
          echo "flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs already cached ($PLATFORM_DIR)"
        else
          echo "seeding flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs from native-v0.17.1-a"
          mkdir -p "$PLATFORM_DIR"
          curl -L --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
            -o /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz \
            https://github.com/DenisovAV/flutter_gemma/releases/download/native-v0.17.1-a/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz
          echo "745b89b606eb712a78f06aed41daca1370eae79b00e0a36054c8e775c0251768  /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
          tar xzf /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz -C "$PLATFORM_DIR"
          # Marker commit point: {version, owner} exactly as the hook's
          # _writeMarker emits it (owner = the hook's _packageName) so the
          # pre-seeded cache keeps a single CodeAsset registrant.
          printf '{"version":"0.17.1-a","owner":"flutter_gemma_litertlm"}\n' > "$MARKER"
        fi
        ls -la "$PLATFORM_DIR"

[.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall/action.yml#937E]
1:name: android-ndk-preinstall
2:description: >-
3:  Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK so Gradle configuration never
4:  triggers an on-demand sdkmanager download mid-build. gh-1655: one
5:  truncated android-ndk-r28c-linux download ("Error on ZipFile unknown
6:  archive" at 33%) red'd the ci.yml build-android leg — and the aggregate
7:  Quality gate with it — because AGP's in-configuration auto-install path
8:  has NO retry. The NDK version is resolved from the pinned Flutter SDK's
9:  own gradle plugin source (the exact value flutter.ndkVersion resolves
10:  to — no second pin to drift), the install is skipped when the NDK is
11:  already present, and the download itself is bounded-retried — the same
12:  hardening the flutter_gemma Android seed carries (gh-1468). Companion
13:  guard: test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart.
14:runs:
15:  using: composite
16:  steps:
17:    - name: Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK (bounded retry)
18:      shell: bash
19:      run: |
20:        set -euo pipefail
21:        # flutter.ndkVersion's single source of truth: the gradle plugin
22:        # bundled with the SDK flutter-action installed. app/
23:        # build.gradle.kts reads `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion`, so
24:        # resolving here can never skew from what AGP requests at
25:        # configuration time (a literal pin on either side would break
26:        # that coupling — the guard test pins both sides).
27:        if [ -n "${FLUTTER_ROOT:-}" ]; then
28:          FLUTTER_HOME="$FLUTTER_ROOT"
29:        else
30:          FLUTTER_BIN="$(command -v flutter || true)"
31:          if [ -z "$FLUTTER_BIN" ]; then
32:            echo "::error::cannot locate flutter (set FLUTTER_ROOT) — the NDK pre-install resolves the version from the SDK's gradle plugin source"
33:            exit 1
34:          fi
35:          FLUTTER_HOME="$(dirname "$(dirname "$FLUTTER_BIN")")"
36:        fi
37:        GRADLE_SRC="$FLUTTER_HOME/packages/flutter_tools/gradle/src/main/kotlin/FlutterExtension.kt"
38:        NDK_VERSION="$(grep -hoE 'val ndkVersion: String = "[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+"' "$GRADLE_SRC" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | head -1 || true)"
39:        if [ -z "$NDK_VERSION" ]; then
40:          echo "::error::cannot resolve flutter.ndkVersion from $GRADLE_SRC — the Flutter gradle plugin layout moved; update the extraction in .github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall (and test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart) TOGETHER"
41:          exit 1
42:        fi
43:        echo "resolved flutter.ndkVersion = $NDK_VERSION"
44:        ANDROID_SDK="${ANDROID_HOME:-/usr/local/lib/android/sdk}"
45:        SDKMANAGER="$ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager"
46:        if [ ! -x "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
47:          SDKMANAGER="$(command -v sdkmanager || true)"
48:        fi
49:        if [ -z "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
50:          echo "::error::sdkmanager not found (expected $ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager) — the NDK pre-install needs the Android cmdline-tools"
51:          exit 1
52:        fi
53:        # Idempotence: AGP resolves `ndkVersion` against
54:        # $ANDROID_HOME/ndk/<version> — source.properties present means
55:        # the NDK is fully installed; skip the download entirely.
56:        if [ -f "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION/source.properties" ]; then
57:          echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION already installed — skipping pre-install"
58:          exit 0
59:        fi
60:        # Accept any license the image has not pre-accepted so the
61:        # installs below never prompt (|| true: `yes` dies of SIGPIPE by
62:        # design once sdkmanager stops reading).
63:        yes | "$SDKMANAGER" --licenses > /dev/null || true
64:        # gh-1655: Gradle's own auto-install (the same sdkmanager call,
65:        # run inside configuration) has no retry — one truncated download
66:        # unzips as "Error on ZipFile unknown archive" and the build dies.
67:        # Here the same download gets three attempts with backoff.
68:        for attempt in 1 2 3; do
69:          echo "installing NDK $NDK_VERSION (attempt $attempt/3)"
70:          rm -rf "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION"
71:          if "$SDKMANAGER" --install "ndk;$NDK_VERSION"; then
72:            echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION installed"
73:            exit 0
74:          fi
75:          echo "::warning::sdkmanager NDK install failed (attempt $attempt/3) — retrying in 10s"
76:          sleep 10
77:        done
78:        echo "::error::NDK $NDK_VERSION install failed after 3 attempts — gh-1655 red'd the leg on a single truncated archive; inspect the sdkmanager output above"
79:        exit 1

name: android-ndk-preinstall
description: >-
  Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK so Gradle configuration never
  triggers an on-demand sdkmanager download mid-build. gh-1655: one
  truncated android-ndk-r28c-linux download ("Error on ZipFile unknown
  archive" at 33%) red'd the ci.yml build-android leg — and the aggregate
  Quality gate with it — because AGP's in-configuration auto-install path
  has NO retry. The NDK version is resolved from the pinned Flutter SDK's
  own gradle plugin source (the exact value flutter.ndkVersion resolves
  to — no second pin to drift), the install is skipped when the NDK is
  already present, and the download itself is bounded-retried — the same
  hardening the flutter_gemma Android seed carries (gh-1468). Companion
  guard: test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart.
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK (bounded retry)
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        # flutter.ndkVersion's single source of truth: the gradle plugin
        # bundled with the SDK flutter-action installed. app/
        # build.gradle.kts reads `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion`, so
        # resolving here can never skew from what AGP requests at
        # configuration time (a literal pin on either side would break
        # that coupling — the guard test pins both sides).
        if [ -n "${FLUTTER_ROOT:-}" ]; then
          FLUTTER_HOME="$FLUTTER_ROOT"
        else
          FLUTTER_BIN="$(command -v flutter || true)"
          if [ -z "$FLUTTER_BIN" ]; then
            echo "::error::cannot locate flutter (set FLUTTER_ROOT) — the NDK pre-install resolves the version from the SDK's gradle plugin source"
            exit 1
          fi
          FLUTTER_HOME="$(dirname "$(dirname "$FLUTTER_BIN")")"
        fi
        GRADLE_SRC="$FLUTTER_HOME/packages/flutter_tools/gradle/src/main/kotlin/FlutterExtension.kt"
        NDK_VERSION="$(grep -hoE 'val ndkVersion: String = "[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+"' "$GRADLE_SRC" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | head -1 || true)"
        if [ -z "$NDK_VERSION" ]; then
          echo "::error::cannot resolve flutter.ndkVersion from $GRADLE_SRC — the Flutter gradle plugin layout moved; update the extraction in .github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall (and test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart) TOGETHER"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "resolved flutter.ndkVersion = $NDK_VERSION"
        ANDROID_SDK="${ANDROID_HOME:-/usr/local/lib/android/sdk}"
        SDKMANAGER="$ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager"
        if [ ! -x "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
          SDKMANAGER="$(command -v sdkmanager || true)"
        fi
        if [ -z "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
          echo "::error::sdkmanager not found (expected $ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager) — the NDK pre-install needs the Android cmdline-tools"
          exit 1
        fi
        # Idempotence: AGP resolves `ndkVersion` against
        # $ANDROID_HOME/ndk/<version> — source.properties present means
        # the NDK is fully installed; skip the download entirely.
        if [ -f "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION/source.properties" ]; then
          echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION already installed — skipping pre-install"
          exit 0
        fi
        # Accept any license the image has not pre-accepted so the
        # installs below never prompt (|| true: `yes` dies of SIGPIPE by
        # design once sdkmanager stops reading).
        yes | "$SDKMANAGER" --licenses > /dev/null || true
        # gh-1655: Gradle's own auto-install (the same sdkmanager call,
        # run inside configuration) has no retry — one truncated download
        # unzips as "Error on ZipFile unknown archive" and the build dies.
        # Here the same download gets three attempts with backoff.
        for attempt in 1 2 3; do
          echo "installing NDK $NDK_VERSION (attempt $attempt/3)"
          rm -rf "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION"
          if "$SDKMANAGER" --install "ndk;$NDK_VERSION"; then
            echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION installed"
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "::warning::sdkmanager NDK install failed (attempt $attempt/3) — retrying in 10s"
          sleep 10
        done
        echo "::error::NDK $NDK_VERSION install failed after 3 attempts — gh-1655 red'd the leg on a single truncated archive; inspect the sdkmanager output above"
        exit 1

name: flutter-gemma-android-seed
description: >-
  Pre-seed the flutter_gemma LiteRT-LM Android native cache so the
  flutter_gemma_litertlm build hook never downloads
  litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz mid-build. gh-1468: one HTTP 500 from the
  github.com release-asset CDN during that download red'd the ci.yml
  build-android leg (and the aggregate Quality gate with it). The hook
  short-circuits the download entirely once libLiteRtLm.so and a matching
  .flutter_gemma_native_version marker exist in the cache — same
  hardening the macOS legs carry via "Ensure flutter_gemma macOS companion
  dylibs". The version/checksum below MUST equal the hook's _litertlmBundle
  registration in the pinned flutter_gemma_litertlm (hook/build.dart);
  test/ci_gemma_android_seed_guard_test.dart AC3 cross-checks both sides.
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Seed flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        GEMMA_CACHE="$HOME/.cache/flutter_gemma/native"
        PLATFORM_DIR="$GEMMA_CACHE/android_arm64"
        MARKER="$GEMMA_CACHE/.flutter_gemma_native_version"
        # The hook's cache-dedup predicate: main lib present AND the
        # marker carries this bundle's exact version (its
        # _invalidateBundleCacheIfStale wipes owned files on a version
        # mismatch, so a stale seed would be deleted and re-downloaded
        # mid-build — the roulette this action exists to stop).
        if [ -f "$PLATFORM_DIR/libLiteRtLm.so" ] && \
           grep -q '"version":"0.17.1-a"\|"version": *"0.17.1-a"' "$MARKER" 2>/dev/null; then
          echo "flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs already cached ($PLATFORM_DIR)"
        else
          echo "seeding flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs from native-v0.17.1-a"
          mkdir -p "$PLATFORM_DIR"
          curl -L --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
            -o /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz \
            https://github.com/DenisovAV/flutter_gemma/releases/download/native-v0.17.1-a/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz
          echo "745b89b606eb712a78f06aed41daca1370eae79b00e0a36054c8e775c0251768  /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
          tar xzf /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz -C "$PLATFORM_DIR"
          # Marker commit point: {version, owner} exactly as the hook's
          # _writeMarker emits it (owner = the hook's _packageName) so the
          # pre-seeded cache keeps a single CodeAsset registrant.
          printf '{"version":"0.17.1-a","owner":"flutter_gemma_litertlm"}\n' > "$MARKER"
        fi
        ls -la "$PLATFORM_DIR"

Actually `:jni` is the standard module name used by **native assets** (`package:native_assets_cli`) in Flutter: the synthetic Gradle module for native code is called `jni`. Yes! Flutter's native-assets support creates a `:jni` subproject in the android build (in `flutter_app/android/build/jni` or similar) configured with CMake. The cmake version comes from... hmm.

Actually let me check the pub cache for flutter_gemma_litertlm and see its hook/build.dart. But first — what cmake does AGP request? The failing task is `:jni:configureCMakeDebug[arm64-v8a]` and the component auto-installed is `cmake;3.22.1` — the AGP default CMake version (AGP's default is 3.22.1 since AGP 7.x).

The GitHub ubuntu-latest runner image preinstalls specific CMake versions in the Android SDK: `$ANDROID_HOME/cmake/<version>`. Historically: 3.6.411459, 3.10.2, 3.18.1, 3.22.1, 3.30.x... {"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Release v1.0.619 went red on three CI jobs — Build Android APK (debug), Quality gate, Advance vpinned marker — with a single root cause: the Android APK build died installing CMake 3.22.1.

**Root cause**: `flutter build apk` failed in Gradle configuration at task `:jni:configureCMakeDebug[arm64-v8a]` with `InstallFailedException: Failed to install the following SDK components: cmake;3.22.1`, caused by `java.util.zip.ZipException: Archive is not a ZIP archive`. The `:jni` Gradle module is the Flutter plugin of the transitive dependency `jni 1.1.0` (pulled in by `path_provider_android 2.3.1`); its `android/build.gradle` wires `externalNativeBuild.cmake` with the version line commented out upstream (`// version "3.10.2"`), so AGP 9.0.1 (`flutter_app/android/settings.gradle.kts`) falls back to its default CMake 3.22.1. The runner image carries no `$ANDROID_HOME/cmake/3.22.1`, so AGP ran its own in-configuration sdkmanager auto-install — which has NO retry. The download came back truncated/corrupt and the unzip blew up, red'ing the leg. This is exactly the gh-1655 failure class (NDK auto-install, fixed by `.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall`), re-entered through the second SDK component the same configuration step provisions: CMake. The existing action hardens only the NDK download.

**Impact**: One corrupt `cmake;3.22.1` download reds the build-android leg (and identically the release/nightly Android lanes, which ride the same un-preinstalled path). Quality gate reds as a pure cascade — its log shows `R_BUILD_ANDROID: failure` as the ONLY failed input (dart_ok stays true per #1368; the required aggregate check is still red). "Advance vpinned marker" reds as a second cascade: `scripts/pin_release.sh v1.0.619` correctly refused to move the `vpinned` marker because the red release published no `SHA256SUMS` provenance asset. Zero code faults — a transfer fault in an unretryable path.

**Fix approach**: Extend `.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall/action.yml` (the gh-1655 action that already bypasses the unretryable auto-install path before Gradle runs) to also pre-install the AGP-default CMake (`cmake;3.22.1`) with the same hardening: idempotent skip when `$ANDROID_HOME/cmake/3.22.1/bin/cmake` already exists, install through sdkmanager with three bounded attempts and backoff, loud `::error::` when the component is still missing. Every Android build job (ci.yml `build-android`, build-mobile.yml `build-android`/`build-android-apks`, nightly.yml `build-release`) already consumes this action before its build step, so the fix covers the whole class without touching the workflows. Extend `test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart` with the CMake acceptance criteria (update TOGETHER, same file-header contract).

**Previous attempt**: none — first fix for gh-1757 (gh-1655/#1755-hardened NDK pre-install passed in this run; CMake was the un-hardened sibling).
"}

[.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall/action.yml#937E]
1:name: android-ndk-preinstall
2:description: >-
3:  Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK so Gradle configuration never
4:  triggers an on-demand sdkmanager download mid-build. gh-1655: one
5:  truncated android-ndk-r28c-linux download ("Error on ZipFile unknown
6:  archive" at 33%) red'd the ci.yml build-android leg — and the aggregate
7:  Quality gate with it — because AGP's in-configuration auto-install path
8:  has NO retry. The NDK version is resolved from the pinned Flutter SDK's
9:  own gradle plugin source (the exact value flutter.ndkVersion resolves
10:  to — no second pin to drift), the install is skipped when the NDK is
11:  already present, and the download itself is bounded-retried — the same
12:  hardening the flutter_gemma Android seed carries (gh-1468). Companion
13:  guard: test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart.
14:runs:
15:  using: composite
16:  steps:
17:    - name: Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK (bounded retry)
18:      shell: bash
19:      run: |
20:        set -euo pipefail
21:        # flutter.ndkVersion's single source of truth: the gradle plugin
22:        # bundled with the SDK flutter-action installed. app/
23:        # build.gradle.kts reads `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion`, so
24:        # resolving here can never skew from what AGP requests at
25:        # configuration time (a literal pin on either side would break
26:        # that coupling — the guard test pins both sides).
27:        if [ -n "${FLUTTER_ROOT:-}" ]; then
28:          FLUTTER_HOME="$FLUTTER_ROOT"
29:        else
30:          FLUTTER_BIN="$(command -v flutter || true)"
31:          if [ -z "$FLUTTER_BIN" ]; then
32:            echo "::error::cannot locate flutter (set FLUTTER_ROOT) — the NDK pre-install resolves the version from the SDK's gradle plugin source"
33:            exit 1
34:          fi
35:          FLUTTER_HOME="$(dirname "$(dirname "$FLUTTER_BIN")")"
36:        fi
37:        GRADLE_SRC="$FLUTTER_HOME/packages/flutter_tools/gradle/src/main/kotlin/FlutterExtension.kt"
38:        NDK_VERSION="$(grep -hoE 'val ndkVersion: String = "[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+"' "$GRADLE_SRC" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | head -1 || true)"
39:        if [ -z "$NDK_VERSION" ]; then
40:          echo "::error::cannot resolve flutter.ndkVersion from $GRADLE_SRC — the Flutter gradle plugin layout moved; update the extraction in .github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall (and test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart) TOGETHER"
41:          exit 1
42:        fi
43:        echo "resolved flutter.ndkVersion = $NDK_VERSION"
44:        ANDROID_SDK="${ANDROID_HOME:-/usr/local/lib/android/sdk}"
45:        SDKMANAGER="$ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager"
46:        if [ ! -x "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
47:          SDKMANAGER="$(command -v sdkmanager || true)"
48:        fi
49:        if [ -z "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
50:          echo "::error::sdkmanager not found (expected $ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager) — the NDK pre-install needs the Android cmdline-tools"
51:          exit 1
52:        fi
53:        # Idempotence: AGP resolves `ndkVersion` against
54:        # $ANDROID_HOME/ndk/<version> — source.properties present means
55:        # the NDK is fully installed; skip the download entirely.
56:        if [ -f "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION/source.properties" ]; then
57:          echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION already installed — skipping pre-install"
58:          exit 0
59:        fi
60:        # Accept any license the image has not pre-accepted so the
61:        # installs below never prompt (|| true: `yes` dies of SIGPIPE by
62:        # design once sdkmanager stops reading).
63:        yes | "$SDKMANAGER" --licenses > /dev/null || true
64:        # gh-1655: Gradle's own auto-install (the same sdkmanager call,
65:        # run inside configuration) has no retry — one truncated download
66:        # unzips as "Error on ZipFile unknown archive" and the build dies.
67:        # Here the same download gets three attempts with backoff.
68:        for attempt in 1 2 3; do
69:          echo "installing NDK $NDK_VERSION (attempt $attempt/3)"
70:          rm -rf "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION"
71:          if "$SDKMANAGER" --install "ndk;$NDK_VERSION"; then
72:            echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION installed"
73:            exit 0
74:          fi
75:          echo "::warning::sdkmanager NDK install failed (attempt $attempt/3) — retrying in 10s"
76:          sleep 10
77:        done
78:        echo "::error::NDK $NDK_VERSION install failed after 3 attempts — gh-1655 red'd the leg on a single truncated archive; inspect the sdkmanager output above"
79:        exit 1
80:

  - Task `:jni:configureCMakeDebug[arm64-v8a]`
  - `com.android.builder.sdk.InstallFailedException: Failed to install the following SDK components: cmake;3.22.1`
  - `Caused by: java.util.zip.ZipException: Archive is not a ZIP archive` — "Install CMake 3.22.1 v.3.22.1" failed.

So the AGP tried to auto-install CMake 3.22.1 into the Android SDK, downloaded a corrupt/non-zip file, and failed. This is the classic "SDK component auto-download got an HTML error page / corrupt archive" issue, OR the sdkmanager license/proxy issue where the "downloaded" file isn't a zip.

There's a CI step `./.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall` that passed — it probably preinstalls NDK + cmake. Let me look at that action to see what it preinstalls — maybe it installs a specific CMake version but the jni module's build.gradle.kts pins a different one (3.22.1), and auto-install kicked in and failed.

The interesting part: the ticket mentions the repo has a `jni` package? `:jni:configureCMakeDebug` — there's a Gradle module named `jni` in flutter_app/android. Let me explore:

- `flutter_app/android/jni/build.gradle.kts` — externalNativeBuild with cmake version
- `.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall/action.yml` — what it preinstalls

The fix options:
1. Make CI preinstall `cmake;3.22.1` via sdkmanager before the build (so AGP doesn't auto-install).
2. Pin the cmake version in jni/build.gradle.kts to the one that IS preinstalled.

name: android-ndk-preinstall
description: >-
  Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK so Gradle configuration never
  triggers an on-demand sdkmanager download mid-build. gh-1655: one
  truncated android-ndk-r28c-linux download ("Error on ZipFile unknown
  archive" at 33%) red'd the ci.yml build-android leg — and the aggregate
  Quality gate with it — because AGP's in-configuration auto-install path
  has NO retry. The NDK version is resolved from the pinned Flutter SDK's
  own gradle plugin source (the exact value flutter.ndkVersion resolves
  to — no second pin to drift), the install is skipped when the NDK is
  already present, and the download itself is bounded-retried — the same
  hardening the flutter_gemma Android seed carries (gh-1468). Companion
  guard: test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart.
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK (bounded retry)
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        # flutter.ndkVersion's single source of truth: the gradle plugin
        # bundled with the SDK flutter-action installed. app/
        # build.gradle.kts reads `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion`, so
        # resolving here can never skew from what AGP requests at
        # configuration time (a literal pin on either side would break
        # that coupling — the guard test pins both sides).
        if [ -n "${FLUTTER_ROOT:-}" ]; then
          FLUTTER_HOME="$FLUTTER_ROOT"
        else
          FLUTTER_BIN="$(command -v flutter || true)"
          if [ -z "$FLUTTER_BIN" ]; then
            echo "::error::cannot locate flutter (set FLUTTER_ROOT) — the NDK pre-install resolves the version from the SDK's gradle plugin source"
            exit 1
          fi
          FLUTTER_HOME="$(dirname "$(dirname "$FLUTTER_BIN")")"
        fi
        GRADLE_SRC="$FLUTTER_HOME/packages/flutter_tools/gradle/src/main/kotlin/FlutterExtension.kt"
        NDK_VERSION="$(grep -hoE 'val ndkVersion: String = "[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+"' "$GRADLE_SRC" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | head -1 || true)"
        if [ -z "$NDK_VERSION" ]; then
          echo "::error::cannot resolve flutter.ndkVersion from $GRADLE_SRC — the Flutter gradle plugin layout moved; update the extraction in .github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall (and test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart) TOGETHER"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "resolved flutter.ndkVersion = $NDK_VERSION"
        ANDROID_SDK="${ANDROID_HOME:-/usr/local/lib/android/sdk}"
        SDKMANAGER="$ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager"
        if [ ! -x "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
          SDKMANAGER="$(command -v sdkmanager || true)"
        fi
        if [ -z "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
          echo "::error::sdkmanager not found (expected $ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager) — the NDK pre-install needs the Android cmdline-tools"
          exit 1
        fi
        # Idempotence: AGP resolves `ndkVersion` against
        # $ANDROID_HOME/ndk/<version> — source.properties present means
        # the NDK is fully installed; skip the download entirely.
        if [ -f "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION/source.properties" ]; then
          echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION already installed — skipping pre-install"
          exit 0
        fi
        # Accept any license the image has not pre-accepted so the
        # installs below never prompt (|| true: `yes` dies of SIGPIPE by
        # design once sdkmanager stops reading).
        yes | "$SDKMANAGER" --licenses > /dev/null || true
        # gh-1655: Gradle's own auto-install (the same sdkmanager call,
        # run inside configuration) has no retry — one truncated download
        # unzips as "Error on ZipFile unknown archive" and the build dies.
        # Here the same download gets three attempts with backoff.
        for attempt in 1 2 3; do
          echo "installing NDK $NDK_VERSION (attempt $attempt/3)"
          rm -rf "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION"
          if "$SDKMANAGER" --install "ndk;$NDK_VERSION"; then
            echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION installed"
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "::warning::sdkmanager NDK install failed (attempt $attempt/3) — retrying in 10s"
          sleep 10
        done
        echo "::error::NDK $NDK_VERSION install failed after 3 attempts — gh-1655 red'd the leg on a single truncated archive; inspect the sdkmanager output above"
        exit 1

messages.preview: The failure pattern is identical to gh-1655 (NDK auto-install with no retry) but for **CMake 3.22.1**. The preinstall action only covers the NDK. Let me examine the `:jni` module and the guard test.

blocks.text:
Now it's very clear. The `android-ndk-preinstall` action preinstalls ONLY the NDK (bounded retry, gh-165 fixed a very similar failure for the NDK). But the failing component this time is **CMake 3.22.1** — the `:jni` module's `externalNativeBuild` requests cmake `3.22.1` (the AGP default), and:

1. The GitHub runner image may have some CMake versions preinstalled but apparently NOT `3.22.1` at this point, OR the runner's cmake got removed/changed.
2. AGP attempted an in-configuration auto-install of `cmake;3.22.1` via sdkmanager, the download got a corrupt archive ("Archive is not a ZIP archive"), and — exactly like gh-165 for the NDK — there's no retry, so the build dies.

name: flutter-gemma-android-seed
description: >-
  Pre-seed the flutter_gemma LiteRT-LM Android native cache so the
  flutter_gemma_litertlm build hook never downloads
  litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz mid-build. gh-1468: one HTTP 500 from the
  github.com release-asset CDN during that download red'd the ci.yml
  build-android leg (and the aggregate Quality gate with it). The hook
  short-circuits the download entirely once libLiteRtLm.so and a matching
  .flutter_gemma_native_version marker exist in the cache — same
  hardening the macOS legs carry via "Ensure flutter_gemma macOS companion
  dylibs". The version/checksum below MUST equal the hook's _litertlmBundle
  registration in the pinned flutter_gemma_litertlm (hook/build.dart);
  test/ci_gemma_android_seed_guard_test.dart AC3 cross-checks both sides.
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Seed flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        GEMMA_CACHE="$HOME/.cache/flutter_gemma/native"
        PLATFORM_DIR="$GEMMA_CACHE/android_arm64"
        MARKER="$GEMMA_CACHE/.flutter_gemma_native_version"
        # The hook's cache-dedup predicate: main lib present AND the
        # marker carries this bundle's exact version (its
        # _invalidateBundleCacheIfStale wipes owned files on a version
        # mismatch, so a stale seed would be deleted and re-downloaded
        # mid-build — the roulette this action exists to stop).
        if [ -f "$PLATFORM_DIR/libLiteRtLm.so" ] && \
           grep -q '"version":"0.17.1-a"\|"version": *"0.17.1-a"' "$MARKER" 2>/dev/null; then
          echo "flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs already cached ($PLATFORM_DIR)"
        else
          echo "seeding flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs from native-v0.17.1-a"
          mkdir -p "$PLATFORM_DIR"
          curl -L --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
            -o /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz \
            https://github.com/DenisovAV/flutter_gemma/releases/download/native-v0.17.1-a/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz
          echo "745b89b606eb712a78f06aed41daca1370eae79b00e0a36054c8e775c0251768  /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
          tar xzf /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz -C "$PLATFORM_DIR"
          # Marker commit point: {version, owner} exactly as the hook's
          # _writeMarker emits it (owner = the hook's _packageName) so the
          # pre-seeded cache keeps a single CodeAsset registrant.
          printf '{"version":"0.17.1-a","owner":"flutter_gemma_litertlm"}\n' > "$MARKER"
        fi
        ls -la "$PLATFORM_DIR"

**Bug**: Release v1.0.619 went red on three CI jobs — Build Android APK (debug), Quality gate, Advance vpinned marker — with a single root cause: the Android APK build died installing CMake 3.22.1.

**Root cause**: `flutter build apk` failed in Gradle configuration at task `:jni:configureCMakeDebug[arm64-v8a]` with `InstallFailedException: Failed to install the following SDK components: cmake;3.22.1`, caused by `java.util.zip.ZipException: Archive is not a ZIP archive`. The `:jni` Gradle module is the Flutter plugin of the transitive dependency `jni 1.1.0` (pulled in by `path_provider_android 2.3.1`); its `android/build.gradle` wires `externalNativeBuild.cmake` with the version line commented out upstream (`// version "3.10.2"`), so AGP 9.0.1 (`flutter_app/android/settings.gradle.kts`) falls back to its default CMake 3.22.1. The runner image carries no `$ANDROID_HOME/cmake/3.22.1`, so AGP ran its own in-configuration sdkmanager auto-install — which has NO retry. The download came back truncated/corrupt and the unzip blew up, red'ing the leg. This is exactly the gh-1655 failure class (NDK auto-install, fixed by `.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall`), re-entered through the second SDK component the same configuration step provisions: CMake. The existing action hardens only the NDK download.

**Impact**: One corrupt `cmake;3.22.1` download reds the build-android leg (and identically the release/nightly Android lanes, which ride the same un-preinstalled path). Quality gate reds as a pure cascade — its log shows `R_BUILD_ANDROID: failure` as the ONLY failed input (dart_ok stays true per #1368; the required aggregate check is still red). "Advance vpinned marker" reds as a second cascade: `scripts/pin_release.sh v1.0.619` correctly refused to move the `vpinned` marker because the red release published no `SHA256SUMS` provenance asset. Zero code faults — a transfer fault in an unretryable path.

**Fix approach**: Extend `.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall/action.yml` (the gh-1655 action that already bypasses the unretryable auto-install path before Gradle runs) to also pre-install the AGP-default CMake (`cmake;3.22.1`) with the same hardening: idempotent skip when `$ANDROID_HOME/cmake/3.22.1/bin/cmake` already exists, install through sdkmanager with three bounded attempts and backoff, loud `::error::` when the component is still missing. Every Android build job (ci.yml `build-android`, build-mobile.yml `build-android`/`build-android-apks`, nightly.yml `build-release`) already consumes this action before its build step, so the fix covers the whole class without touching the workflows. **Previous attempt**: none — first fix for gh-1757 (gh-1655/#1755-hardened NDK pre-install passed in this run; CMake was the un-hardened sibling).

[.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall/action.yml#937E]
1:name: android-ndk-preinstall
2:description: >-
3:  Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK so Gradle configuration never
4:  triggers an on-demand sdkmanager download mid-build. gh-1655: one
5:  truncated android-ndk-r28c-linux download ("Error on ZipFile unknown
6:  archive" at 33%) red'd the ci.yml build-android leg — and the aggregate
7:  Quality gate with it — because AGP's in-configuration auto-install path
8:  has NO retry. The NDK version is resolved from the pinned Flutter SDK's
9:  own gradle plugin source (the exact value flutter.ndkVersion resolves
10:  to — no second pin to drift), the install is skipped when the NDK is
11:  already present, and the download itself is bounded-retried — the same
12:  hardening the flutter_gemma Android seed carries (gh-1468). Companion
13:  guard: test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart.
14:runs:
15:  using: composite
16:  steps:
17:    - name: Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK (bounded retry)
18:      shell: bash
19:      run: |
20:        set -euo pipefail
21:        # flutter.ndkVersion's single source of truth: the gradle plugin
22:        # bundled with the SDK flutter-action installed. app/
23:        # build.gradle.kts reads `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion`, so
24:        # resolving here can never skew from what AGP requests at
25:        # configuration time (a literal pin on either side would break
26:        # that coupling — the guard test pins both sides).
27:        if [ -n "${FLUTTER_ROOT:-}" ]; then
28:          FLUTTER_HOME="$FLUTTER_ROOT"
29:        else
30:          FLUTTER_BIN="$(command -v flutter || true)"
31:          if [ -z "$FLUTTER_BIN" ]; then
32:            echo "::error::cannot locate flutter (set FLUTTER_ROOT) — the NDK pre-install resolves the version from the SDK's gradle plugin source"
33:            exit 1
34:          fi
35:          FLUTTER_HOME="$(dirname "$(dirname "$FLUTTER_BIN")")"
36:        fi
37:        GRADLE_SRC="$FLUTTER_HOME/packages/flutter_tools/gradle/src/main/kotlin/FlutterExtension.kt"
38:        NDK_VERSION="$(grep -hoE 'val ndkVersion: String = "[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+"' "$GRADLE_SRC" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | head -1 || true)"
39:        if [ -z "$NDK_VERSION" ]; then
40:          echo "::error::cannot resolve flutter.ndkVersion from $GRADLE_SRC — the Flutter gradle plugin layout moved; update the extraction in .github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall (and test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart) TOGETHER"
41:          exit 1
42:        fi
43:        echo "resolved flutter.ndkVersion = $NDK_VERSION"
44:        ANDROID_SDK="${ANDROID_HOME:-/usr/local/lib/android/sdk}"
45:        SDKMANAGER="$ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager"
46:        if [ ! -x "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
47:          SDKMANAGER="$(command -v sdkmanager || true)"
48:        fi
49:        if [ -z "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
50:          echo "::error::sdkmanager not found (expected $ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager) — the NDK pre-install needs the Android cmdline-tools"
51:          exit 1
52:        fi
53:        # Idempotence: AGP resolves `ndkVersion` against
54:        # $ANDROID_HOME/ndk/<version> — source.properties present means
55:        # the NDK is fully installed; skip the download entirely.
56:        if [ -f "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION/source.properties" ]; then
57:          echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION already installed — skipping pre-install"
58:          exit 0
59:        fi
60:        # Accept any license the image has not pre-accepted so the
61:        # installs below never prompt (|| true: `yes` dies of SIGPIPE by
62:        # design once sdkmanager stops reading).
63:        yes | "$SDKMANAGER" --licenses > /dev/null || true
64:        # gh-1655: Gradle's own auto-install (the same sdkmanager call,
65:        # run inside configuration) has no retry — one truncated download
66:        # unzips as "Error on ZipFile unknown archive" and the build dies.
67:        # Here the same download gets three attempts with backoff.
68:        for attempt in 1 2 3; do

blocks.text:
Now the picture is clear:

1. **Quality gate** failed ONLY because `R_BUILD_ANDROID: failure` — the aggregate is red because the build-android platform leg is red. Every other leg passed. So the Quality gate failure is a downstream cascade of the Android build failure. There's exactly ONE root cause: **Build Android APK (debug)**.

2. **Build Android APK (debug)** failed at step `flutter build apk (debug)`:
  - Task `:jni:configureCMakeDebug[arm64-v8a]`
  - `com.android.builder.sdk.InstallFailedException: Failed to install the following SDK components: cmake;3.22.1`
  - `Caused by: java.util.zip.ZipException: Archive is not a ZIP archive` — "Install CMake 3.22.1 v.3.22.1" failed.

So the AGP tried to auto-install CMake 3.22.1 into the Android SDK, downloaded a corrupt/non-zip file, and failed. This is the classic "SDK component auto-download got an HTML error page / corrupt archive" issue, OR the sdkmanager license/proxy issue where the "downloaded" file isn't a zip.

There's a CI step `./.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall` that passed — it probably preinstalls NDK + cmake. Let me look at that action to see what it preinstalls — maybe it installs a specific CMake version but the jni module's build.gradle.kts pins a different one (3.22.1), and auto-install kicked in and failed.

The interesting part: the ticket mentions the repo has a `jni` package? `:jni:configureCMakeDebug` — there's a Gradle module named `jni` in flutter_app/android. Let me explore:

- `flutter_app/android/` settings.gradle.kts — includes `:jni`
- `flutter_app/android/jni/build.gradle.kts` — externalNativeBuild with cmake version
- `.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall/action.yml` — what it preinstalls

The fix options:
1. Make CI preinstall `cmake;3.22.1` via sdkmanager before the build (so AGP doesn't auto-install).
2. Pin the cmake version in jni/build.gradle.kts to the one that IS preinstalled.

Let me look at the files. Also — importantly — the ticket says the failures were on the tag v1.0.619. Is this failure still present on main HEAD? The relevant files (android config, CI workflow) probably didn't change between v1.0.619 and main (#1754 only touched compaction code). So yes, still broken.

Note the "Advance vpinned marker" job also failed — job 119439481402. Let me check that one too; it might be a different failure (maybe it failed because the run was red). Let me check.

name: android-ndk-preinstall
description: >-
  Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK so Gradle configuration never
  triggers an on-demand sdkmanager download mid-build. gh-1655: one
  truncated android-ndk-r28c-linux download ("Error on ZipFile unknown
  archive" at 33%) red'd the ci.yml build-android leg — and the aggregate
  Quality gate with it — because AGP's in-configuration auto-install path
  has NO retry. The NDK version is resolved from the pinned Flutter SDK's
  own gradle plugin source (the exact value flutter.ndkVersion resolves
  to — no second pin to drift), the install is skipped when the NDK is
  already present, and the download itself is bounded-retried — the same
  hardening the flutter_gemma Android seed carries (gh-1468). Companion
  guard: test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart.
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK (bounded retry)
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        # flutter.ndkVersion's single source of truth: the gradle plugin
        # bundled with the SDK flutter-action installed. app/
        # build.gradle.kts reads `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion`, so
        # resolving here can never skew from what AGP requests at
        # configuration time (a literal pin on either side would break
        # that coupling — the guard test pins both sides).
        if [ -n "${FLUTTER_ROOT:-}" ]; then
          FLUTTER_HOME="$FLUTTER_ROOT"
        else
          FLUTTER_BIN="$(command -v flutter || true)"
          if [ -z "$FLUTTER_BIN" ]; then
            echo "::error::cannot locate flutter (set FLUTTER_ROOT) — the NDK pre-install resolves the version from the SDK's gradle plugin source"
            exit 1
          fi
          FLUTTER_HOME="$(dirname "$(dirname "$FLUTTER_BIN")")"
        fi
        GRADLE_SRC="$FLUTTER_HOME/packages/flutter_tools/gradle/src/main/kotlin/FlutterExtension.kt"
        NDK_VERSION="$(grep -hoE 'val ndkVersion: String = "[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+"' "$GRADLE_SRC" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | head -1 || true)"
        if [ -z "$NDK_VERSION" ]; then
          echo "::error::cannot resolve flutter.ndkVersion from $GRADLE_SRC — the Flutter gradle plugin layout moved; update the extraction in .github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall (and test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart) TOGETHER"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "resolved flutter.ndkVersion = $NDK_VERSION"
        ANDROID_SDK="${ANDROID_HOME:-/usr/local/lib/android/sdk}"
        SDKMANAGER="$ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager"
        if [ ! -x "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
          SDKMANAGER="$(command -v sdkmanager || true)"
        fi
        if [ -z "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
          echo "::error::sdkmanager not found (expected $ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager) — the NDK pre-install needs the Android cmdline-tools"
          exit 1
        fi
        # Idempotence: AGP resolves `ndkVersion` against
        # $ANDROID_HOME/ndk/<version> — source.properties present means
        # the NDK is fully installed; skip the download entirely.
        if [ -f "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION/source.properties" ]; then
          echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION already installed — skipping pre-install"
          exit 0
        fi
        # Accept any license the image has not pre-accepted so the
        # installs below never prompt (|| true: `yes` dies of SIGPIPE by
        # design once sdkmanager stops reading).
        yes | "$SDKMANAGER" --licenses > /dev/null || true
        # gh-1655: Gradle's own auto-install (the same sdkmanager call,
        # run inside configuration) has no retry — one truncated download
        # unzips as "Error on ZipFile unknown archive" and the build dies.
        # Here the same download gets three attempts with backoff.
        for attempt in 1 2 3; do
          echo "installing NDK $NDK_VERSION (attempt $attempt/3)"
          rm -rf "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION"
          if "$SDKMANAGER" --install "ndk;$NDK_VERSION"; then
            echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION installed"
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "::warning::sdkmanager NDK install failed (attempt $attempt/3) — retrying in 10s"
          sleep 10
        done
        echo "::error::NDK $NDK_VERSION install failed after 3 attempts — gh-1655 red'd the leg on a single truncated archive; inspect the sdkmanager output above"
        exit 1

name: flutter-gemma-android-seed
description: >-
  Pre-seed the flutter_gemma LiteRT-LM Android native cache so the
  flutter_gemma_litertlm build hook never downloads
  litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz mid-build. gh-1468: one HTTP 500 from the
  github.com release-asset CDN during that download red'd the ci.yml
  build-android leg (and the aggregate Quality gate with it). The hook
  short-circuits the download entirely once libLiteRtLm.so and a matching
  .flutter_gemma_native_version marker exist in the cache — same
  hardening the macOS legs carry via "Ensure flutter_gemma macOS companion
  dylibs". The version/checksum below MUST equal the hook's _litertlmBundle
  registration in the pinned flutter_gemma_litertlm (hook/build.dart);
  test/ci_gemma_android_seed_guard_test.dart AC3 cross-checks both sides.
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Seed flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        GEMMA_CACHE="$HOME/.cache/flutter_gemma/native"
        PLATFORM_DIR="$GEMMA_CACHE/android_arm64"
        MARKER="$GEMMA_CACHE/.flutter_gemma_native_version"
        # The hook's cache-dedup predicate: main lib present AND the
        # marker carries this bundle's exact version (its
        # _invalidateBundleCacheIfStale wipes owned files on a version
        # mismatch, so a stale seed would be deleted and re-downloaded
        # mid-build — the roulette this action exists to stop).
        if [ -f "$PLATFORM_DIR/libLiteRtLm.so" ] && \
           grep -q '"version":"0.17.1-a"\|"version": *"0.17.1-a"' "$MARKER" 2>/dev/null; then
          echo "flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs already cached ($PLATFORM_DIR)"
        else
          echo "seeding flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs from native-v0.17.1-a"
          mkdir -p "$PLATFORM_DIR"
          curl -L --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
            -o /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz \
            https://github.com/DenisovAV/flutter_gemma/releases/download/native-v0.17.1-a/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz
          echo "745b89b606eb712a78f06aed41daca1370eae79b00e0a36054c8e775c0251768  /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
          tar xzf /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz -C "$PLATFORM_DIR"
          # Marker commit point: {version, owner} exactly as the hook's
          # _writeMarker emits it (owner = the hook's _packageName) so the
          # pre-seeded cache keeps a single CodeAsset registrant.
          printf '{"version":"0.17.1-a","owner":"flutter_gemma_litertlm"}\n' > "$MARKER"
        fi
        ls -la "$PLATFORM_DIR"

Wait — is it right to extend the NDK action vs. adding a cmake step? The action is named "android-ndk-preinstall"; its description says "Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK so Gradle configuration never triggers an on-demand sdkmanager download mid-build. gh-165: ..." The description can be updated to cover the same class for CMake (the `:jni` plugin module's AGP-default CMake 3.22.1). The guard test already enumerates all android build jobs and asserts the action runs before build steps — extending the SAME action keeps AC2/AC3 intact for all sites (ci.yml build-android, build-mobile.yml build-android + build-android-apks, nightly.yml build-release). That's the class-complete fix without touching three workflows.

[.github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall/action.yml#937E]
1:name: android-ndk-preinstall
2:description: >-
3:  Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK so Gradle configuration never
4:  triggers an on-demand sdkmanager download mid-build. gh-1655: one
5:  truncated android-ndk-r28c-linux download ("Error on ZipFile unknown
6:  archive" at 33%) red'd the ci.yml build-android leg — and the aggregate
7:  Quality gate with it — because AGP's in-configuration auto-install path
8:  has NO retry. The NDK version is resolved from the pinned Flutter SDK's
9:  own gradle plugin source (the exact value flutter.ndkVersion resolves
10:  to — no second pin to drift), the install is skipped when the NDK is
11:  already present, and the download itself is bounded-retried — the same
12:  hardening the flutter_gemma Android seed carries (gh-1468). Companion
13:  guard: test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart.
14:runs:
15:  using: composite
16:  steps:
17:    - name: Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK (bounded retry)
18:      shell: bash
19:      run: |
20:        set -euo pipefail
21:        # flutter.ndkVersion's single source of truth: the gradle plugin
22:        # bundled with the SDK flutter-action installed. app/
23:        # build.gradle.kts reads `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion`, so
24:        # resolving here can never skew from what AGP requests at
25:        # configuration time (a literal pin on either side would break
26:        # that coupling — the guard test pins both sides).
27:        if [ -n "${FLUTTER_ROOT:-}" ]; then
28:          FLUTTER_HOME="$FLUTTER_ROOT"
29:        else
30:          FLUTTER_BIN="$(command -v flutter || true)"
31:          if [ -z "$FLUTTER_BIN" ]; then
32:            echo "::error::cannot locate flutter (set FLUTTER_ROOT) — the NDK pre-install resolves the version from the SDK's gradle plugin source"
33:            exit 1
34:          fi
35:          FLUTTER_HOME="$(dirname "$(dirname "$FLUTTER_BIN")")"
36:        fi
37:        GRADLE_SRC="$FLUTTER_HOME/packages/flutter_tools/gradle/src/main/kotlin/FlutterExtension.kt"
38:        NDK_VERSION="$(grep -hoE 'val ndkVersion: String = "[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+"' "$GRADLE_SRC" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | head -1 || true)"
39:        if [ -z "$NDK_VERSION" ]; then
40:          echo "::error::cannot resolve flutter.ndkVersion from $GRADLE_SRC — the Flutter gradle plugin layout moved; update the extraction in .github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall (and test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart) TOGETHER"
41:          exit 1
42:        fi
43:        echo "resolved flutter.ndkVersion = $NDK_VERSION"
44:        ANDROID_SDK="${ANDROID_HOME:-/usr/local/lib/android/sdk}"
45:        SDKMANAGER="$ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager"
46:        if [ ! -x "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
47:          SDKMANAGER="$(command -v sdkmanager || true)"
48:        fi
49:        if [ -z "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
50:          echo "::error::sdkmanager not found (expected $ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager) — the NDK pre-install needs the Android cmdline-tools"
51:          exit 1
52:        fi
53:        # Idempotence: AGP resolves `ndkVersion` against
54:        # $ANDROID_HOME/ndk/<version> — source.properties present means
55:        # the NDK is fully installed; skip the download entirely.
56:        if [ -f "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION/source.properties" ]; then
57:          echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION already installed — skipping pre-install"
58:          exit 0
59:        fi
60:        # Accept any license the image has not pre-accepted so the
61:        # installs below never prompt (|| true: `yes` dies of SIGPIPE by
62:        # design once sdkmanager stops reading).
63:        yes | "$SDKMANAGER" --licenses > /dev/null || true
64:        # gh-1655: Gradle's own auto-install (the same sdkmanager call,
65:        # run inside configuration) has no retry — one truncated download
66:        # unzips as "Error on ZipFile unknown archive" and the build dies.
67:        # Here the same download gets three attempts with backoff.
68:        for attempt in 1 2 3; do
69:          echo "installing NDK $NDK_VERSION (attempt $attempt/3)"
70:          rm -rf "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION"
71:          if "$SDKMANAGER" --install "ndk;$NDK_VERSION"; then
72:            echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION installed"
73:            exit 0
74:          fi
75:          echo "::warning::sdkmanager NDK install failed (attempt $attempt/3) — retrying in 10s"
76:          sleep 10
77:        done
78:        echo "::error::NDK $NDK_VERSION install failed after 3 attempts — gh-1655 red'd the leg on a single truncated archive; inspect the sdkmanager output above"
79:        exit 1
80:

name: android-ndk-preinstall
description: >-
  Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK so Gradle configuration never
  triggers an on-demand sdkmanager download mid-build. gh-1655: one
  truncated android-ndk-r28c-linux download ("Error on ZipFile unknown
  archive" at 33%) red'd the ci.yml build-android leg — and the aggregate
  Quality gate with it — because AGP's in-configuration auto-install path
  has NO retry. The NDK version is resolved from the pinned Flutter SDK's
  own gradle plugin source (the exact value flutter.ndkVersion resolves
  to — no second pin to drift), the install is skipped when the NDK is
  already present, and the download itself is bounded-retried — the same
  hardening the flutter_gemma Android seed carries (gh-1468). Companion
  guard: test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart.
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Pre-install the Flutter-pinned Android NDK (bounded retry)
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        # flutter.ndkVersion's single source of truth: the gradle plugin
        # bundled with the SDK flutter-action installed. app/
        # build.gradle.kts reads `ndkVersion = flutter.ndkVersion`, so
        # resolving here can never skew from what AGP requests at
        # configuration time (a literal pin on either side would break
        # that coupling — the guard test pins both sides).
        if [ -n "${FLUTTER_ROOT:-}" ]; then
          FLUTTER_HOME="$FLUTTER_ROOT"
        else
          FLUTTER_BIN="$(command -v flutter || true)"
          if [ -z "$FLUTTER_BIN" ]; then
            echo "::error::cannot locate flutter (set FLUTTER_ROOT) — the NDK pre-install resolves the version from the SDK's gradle plugin source"
            exit 1
          fi
          FLUTTER_HOME="$(dirname "$(dirname "$FLUTTER_BIN")")"
        fi
        GRADLE_SRC="$FLUTTER_HOME/packages/flutter_tools/gradle/src/main/kotlin/FlutterExtension.kt"
        NDK_VERSION="$(grep -hoE 'val ndkVersion: String = "[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+"' "$GRADLE_SRC" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | head -1 || true)"
        if [ -z "$NDK_VERSION" ]; then
          echo "::error::cannot resolve flutter.ndkVersion from $GRADLE_SRC — the Flutter gradle plugin layout moved; update the extraction in .github/actions/android-ndk-preinstall (and test/ci_android_ndk_preinstall_guard_test.dart) TOGETHER"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "resolved flutter.ndkVersion = $NDK_VERSION"
        ANDROID_SDK="${ANDROID_HOME:-/usr/local/lib/android/sdk}"
        SDKMANAGER="$ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager"
        if [ ! -x "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
          SDKMANAGER="$(command -v sdkmanager || true)"
        fi
        if [ -z "$SDKMANAGER" ]; then
          echo "::error::sdkmanager not found (expected $ANDROID_SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager) — the NDK pre-install needs the Android cmdline-tools"
          exit 1
        fi
        # Idempotence: AGP resolves `ndkVersion` against
        # $ANDROID_HOME/ndk/<version> — source.properties present means
        # the NDK is fully installed; skip the download entirely.
        if [ -f "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION/source.properties" ]; then
          echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION already installed — skipping pre-install"
          exit 0
        fi
        # Accept any license the image has not pre-accepted so the
        # installs below never prompt (|| true: `yes` dies of SIGPIPE by
        # design once sdkmanager stops reading).
        yes | "$SDKMANAGER" --licenses > /dev/null || true
        # gh-1655: Gradle's own auto-install (the same sdkmanager call,
        # run inside configuration) has no retry — one truncated download
        # unzips as "Error on ZipFile unknown archive" and the build dies.
        # Here the same download gets three attempts with backoff.
        for attempt in 1 2 3; do
          echo "installing NDK $NDK_VERSION (attempt $attempt/3)"
          rm -rf "$ANDROID_SDK/ndk/$NDK_VERSION"
          if "$SDKMANAGER" --install "ndk;$NDK_VERSION"; then
            echo "NDK $NDK_VERSION installed"
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "::warning::sdkmanager NDK install failed (attempt $attempt/3) — retrying in 10s"
          sleep 10
        done
        echo "::error::NDK $NDK_VERSION install failed after 3 attempts — gh-1655 red'd the leg on a single truncated archive; inspect the sdkmanager output above"
        exit 1
